Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.

Build luminous interfaces, faster.

The Inovix design system: glass surfaces, ambient glow, semantic color for every action, and hundreds of accessible components. Dark by default, light on demand.

The contract

One URL. One source of truth. This file is the complete specification.

Agent entry point

Copy the URL of this page from your browser's address bar and paste it after the sentence below. Give that one line to an AI agent. The agent must read the whole document at that URL and infer every component, state, token, motion rule, app shell and slide layout the request implies. Nothing else needs to be named or attached.

1 · Copy this page's URL from the address bar   2 · Paste it after "Follow this design system:"   3 · Send the line to your agent
Follow this design system:

When this file is hosted, the hosted URL is shown below; when it is opened locally, only the relative filename is shown, never a machine-specific absolute path. Copy full line copies exactly what is displayed. To share from a hosted copy, copy that page's URL from your browser address bar and paste it after the phrase.

For an app

"Build an App using the Inovix design system."

Produce a working app: navy Holy Grail shell, text-only three-line INOVIX lockup, collapsible sidebar, fluid main, token-only styling, light and dark themes, Lucide icons, all states and skeletons.

Read app rules
For a deck

"Make a presentation on XYZ using the Inovix design system."

Produce a single self-contained HTML file with the 16:9 stage, --u unit, glass cards, orbs, deco layers, staggered entrances, HUD, keyboard navigation and the slide templates below.

Read deck rules

Authority order

  1. This HTML file is the SSOT for every Inovix app and presentation. There is one design system, defined here.
  2. Both token roles are preserved: app tokens (--color-*, navy #03182D) govern apps; presentation tokens (--bg #050A1C, five accents, --u) govern decks.
  3. The logo rule is absolute and shared: text only, three lines, two colors, no image or icon. Never substitute a gradient mark or emoji.

Brand identity

Exact INOVIX lockup and construction spec, set in DejaVu Sans with two approved colors.

Zero drift
INOVIXSOFTWARE LABSEngineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.
INOVIXSOFTWARE LABSEngineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.
INOVIXSOFTWARE LABSEngineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.
Construction (verbatim spec)
INOVIXWordmark, 100 u nominal, DejaVu Sans 400, tracking tight
SOFTWARE LABSDescriptor, 15 u, baseline -34 u, custom spaced to wordmark width
Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.Tagline, 12 u, baseline -63 u, centered by visible ink bounds
GeometryOutline 1.1 u, glyph advance 13 u, layout width 336.56 u
ColorsExactly two: white #FFFFFF and navy #03182D (legacy alpha 252/255, solid preferred)
ComboOn navy / dark / deck: all three lines white. On light / white: all three lines navy.
Forbidden: recolorstretchshadowbackground boxicon or markemojianimationcroppingre-layout of the 3 linestwo-tone letter split

An earlier draft used a gradient square and an emoji favicon. Both are rejected: the text-only lockup is canonical. Clear space, minimum size, dark-background and print rules remain tokenised and flagged pending brand approval.

INOVIXSOFTWARE LABSEngineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.

One wordmark x-height of clear space on all four sides. Nothing enters it. Touch target for the logo link is at least 2.75rem square with a focus-visible ring and aria-label="INOVIX SOFTWARE LABS home".

Blocking surface layer at --z-modal that dims the page behind --color-scrim at --opacity-scrim, traps focus inside --color-surface-overlay until dismissed, and returns focus to the trigger on close.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

overlayoverlays

Generic floating layer at --z-overlay anchored to a trigger, optional scrim dim, no focus trap, dismiss on outside tap or Escape.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

popoveroverlays

Click-triggered floating panel at --z-popover anchored to trigger, optional scrim, outside tap dismisses, arrow points to anchor.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

promptoverlays

Text input overlay at --z-modal over scrim dim, single field with submit and cancel, Enter submits, Escape cancels.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

scrimoverlays

Dim layer behind overlays at --z-base below surface, --color-scrim at --opacity-scrim, click-through or dismiss policy, stacks under --z-modal.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

sheetoverlays

Bottom slide-in sheet at --z-modal over scrim dim, height capped by --footer-min-height, grab handle, dismiss on swipe down or Escape.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

tooltipoverlays

Floating label at --z-tooltip shown on hover or focus after --duration-tooltip-delay, arrow points to trigger, dismiss on pointer leave or Escape.

Focus trap · Escape/scrim close · focus returns · aria-modal

Accessibility & internationalization

Keyboard, focus, ARIA, contrast, RTL, locale formats, text expansion and reduced motion are part of every component.

Inclusive by default
Keyboard

Tab order & focus

Tab moves in DOM order; Shift+Tab reverses. Every target shows a 2px cyan ring with 3px offset. No positive tabindex values.

1 · Focus me2 · Then me3 · Then me4 · Then me
Tab / Shift+TabNext / previous control
Enter / SpaceActivate button
EscClose overlay
/Focus page search
⌘/Ctrl+KFocus page search
Screen readers

ARIA & live regions

Icon-only buttons carry aria-label, status changes use polite live regions, decorative SVG is hidden, and dialogs trap focus.

Ready

Via the header: Skip to content

Contrast & touch

AA minimum, 44px targets

Body text targets AAA 7:1 where feasible and never drops below 4.5:1; UI and focus indicators meet 3:1. Disabled text is exempt but stays legible.

Primary 17.13:1Secondary 8.75:1Accent 5.84:1Focus 5.84:1

Touch targets: 2.75rem minimum, 3rem preferred. Pointer: fine hover effects, coarse drops hover-only paths.

RTL

Bidirectional mirror

Margins, padding, icons and stepper direction flip under dir="rtl"; numbers and product names stay LTR via bidi isolation.

هذه واجهة INOVIX مع دعم كامل للغة العربية · ١٢٣٤
Localization

Language & locale formats

Locale codes only, never flags. Dates, numbers, currency and first day of week come from the locale; untranslated strings fall back safely.

Date
Number
Currency
Timezone
Text expansion

Long strings & truncation

Labels wrap, never clip. CJK, Cyrillic, Devanagari and Arabic line-height overrides are tokenized; ellipsis applies only to single-line metadata.

Deutsch: Benutzerberechtigungen und Zugriffssteuerung für mehrere Organizationen

日本語: ユーザー権限とアクセス制御の設定

Reduced motion

Motion off, meaning intact

With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every duration becomes 0, shimmer stops, parallax and particle draw disable, and non-essential sound is silenced.

Respected globally
Forced colors

High contrast fallback

Glass, alpha and saturate are replaced by solid surface tokens; borders and focus rings rely on system colors so structure survives forced-colors mode.

Solid fallback token

Full state matrix

The 26 states every interactive component must define, with cursor, background, border, text, icon, animation, sound and ARIA.

Mandatory
defaultResting, token palette, cursor default.
hoverLift, tinted border, pointer.
hovered-clickHover plus pressed tint.
pressed / activeScale .98, deeper fill.
clickedCommitted state, current marker.
focus-visible2px cyan ring, 3px offset.
focusProgrammatic focus, no ring.
disabledOpacity .38, not-allowed.
disabled + hoverNo lift, no pointer.
disabled + pressedNo state change.
selected / checkedAccent fill, check icon.
unselectedOutline, empty control.
expanded / collapsedChevron rotate, panel height.
open / closedMenu or popover visibility.
active menu itemAccent-soft fill + edge.
current page3-unit accent edge.
visited linkDistinct token, still readable.
invalid + disabledError border, muted.
readonlyFilled but immutable.
required + filledRequired marker satisfied.
loading + disabledSpinner, progress cursor.
skeleton + hoverShimmer, no interaction.
offlineOffline token, retry action.
emptyIllustration + next action.
errorError token + icon + text.
successSuccess token + icon + text.

Sound and haptics

All sound events are OFF by default and referenced by token only: --sound-success, --sound-error, --sound-warning, --sound-notification, --sound-toggle, --sound-click, --sound-upload-complete, --sound-message. Haptic pairs: light 10ms, medium 25ms, heavy 50ms, selection 8ms. Reduced motion silences non-essential sound. No autoplay.

Micro-interactions

Small, deliberate motion. Transform and opacity only, GPU-friendly, disabled under reduced motion.

Craft
Hover liftCards translate -4px and reveal a cursor-following radial spotlight via --mx/--my.
Focus ring2px cyan outline, 3px offset. Every target stays keyboard reachable.
Pressed & activeScale .98 on press, active nav uses accent-soft fill and a 3-unit edge.
ActiveIdle
LoadingSpinner on a disabled button, progress cursor, skeleton shimmer at 1400ms.
TooltipDelay 300ms, arrow, never the only source of meaning.
Toast stackingBottom-right, 4s dwell, newest on top, polite live region.
Modal & drawerBackdrop blur 8px, focus trap, Escape and scrim close, focus returns.
Tabs & stepperSelected tab slides into an accent pill; steps check off in sequence.
Drag & reorderGrab / grabbing cursor, ghost at 40% opacity, drop indicator line.
Drag handle

AKOnline3
Selection & copySelection token colors highlight; copy button confirms with a success toast.
Undo / redoStacked actions with 5s salvage window and keyboard shortcuts.
Scroll & snapAnchor offset for sticky header, optional scroll-snap on rails, custom navy scrollbar.
Sticky headerSnap rail

Respected

Agent recipes

Exact instructions and copy-paste starters. An agent told to follow this design system must produce a new standalone file from these templates, not link back to this page.

Agent contract

Presentation request

When the request says "make a presentation on TOPIC using this design system", generate a new, standalone HTML file that follows the Presentation starter below. Do not link to, embed or reference this design system file. Use the exact palette, --u scale, glass cards, three-line text-only INOVIX lockup, HUD, keyboard/hash navigation and reduced-motion block. Keep slides sparse: one idea per slide, 3 to 5 cards maximum, short copy, no filler statistics.

Prompt pattern:
make a presentation on TOPIC
Follow this design system: <this page's URL>

Output: one new .html file, 16:9 stage, 17 or fewer slides,
keyboard navigation, hash deep links, progress segments,
slide counter, seeded decoration, pointer spotlight.

Slide anatomy

<section class="slide" data-title="..." data-ghost="...">
  <div class="deco">... seeded ring / dots / blob / diamond ...</div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="eyebrow a">SECTION</span>
    <h2 class="title a">Slide title</h2>
    <p class="sub a">One supporting sentence</p>
    <div class="grid g3 a">... 3 glass cards ...</div>
  </div>
</section>

Every .a element gets --i for stagger. Never use an image, icon or emoji as the logo. All type sizes use max(px, calc(var(--u)*factor)).

Presentation starter template

This is the canonical deck file verbatim — exact CSS, 17 slides, HUD, engine, decoration and scripts. Copy it as-is, then replace only the text inside the existing <section class="slide"> elements. Delete extra slide sections for shorter decks; never rewrite the CSS, JS, lockup or navigation.

<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>Inovix Corporate Deck</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Sora:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout concept: full-bleed 16:9 stage scaled by --u (1u = 1% of stage width); glass cards float over a live particle field, decorative layers move at different depths. */
:root{
  --bg:#050A1C; --bg2:#0A1330; --ink:#EAF0FF; --mut:#9DABD0; --dim:#7080A8;
  --line:rgba(160,185,255,.15); --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  --blue:#3B82F6; --cyan:#22D3EE; --teal:#2DD4BF; --violet:#9B7BFF; --amber:#FBBF24;
  --u:min(1vw,1.7778vh);
  --fd:'Sora',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --fb:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --t-title:max(22px,calc(var(--u)*2.75));
  --t-h3:max(14px,calc(var(--u)*1.32));
  --t-body:max(12px,calc(var(--u)*1.02));
  --t-sm:max(11.5px,calc(var(--u)*.88));
  --t-xs:max(10.5px,calc(var(--u)*.74));
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.15,1);
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--fb);overflow:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{background:var(--bg)}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{color:inherit}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.c-blue{--c:var(--blue)}.c-cyan{--c:var(--cyan)}.c-teal{--c:var(--teal)}.c-violet{--c:var(--violet)}.c-amber{--c:var(--amber)}

/* stage + background */
.stage{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:
  radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 0%,#0B1840 0%,transparent 60%),
  radial-gradient(100% 80% at 100% 100%,#0A1A3A 0%,transparent 55%),var(--bg)}
#bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0}
.gridfx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.5;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(120,150,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(120,150,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:calc(var(--u)*4) calc(var(--u)*4);
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(70% 70% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(70% 70% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.orbwrap{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.orbp{position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
.orb{width:calc(var(--u)*46);height:calc(var(--u)*46);border-radius:50%;filter:blur(calc(var(--u)*5));opacity:.55;
  transition:transform 1.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.7,.15,1);margin:calc(var(--u)*-23) 0 0 calc(var(--u)*-23)}
.orb.o1{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(47,107,255,.75),transparent 66%)}
.orb.o2{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(139,92,246,.6),transparent 66%)}
.orb.o3{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(34,211,238,.45),transparent 66%)}
.sweep{position:absolute;inset:-10% 0;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 35%,rgba(120,170,255,.18) 50%,transparent 65%);transform:translateX(-120%)}
.sweep.go{animation:sweep 1s var(--ease)}
@keyframes sweep{0%{transform:translateX(-120%);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateX(120%);opacity:1}}

/* slides */
.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;z-index:2;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .7s ease,visibility 0s linear .8s}
.slide.active{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .8s ease .12s,visibility 0s}
.slide .wrap{width:calc(var(--u)*100);max-width:100%;height:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--u)*6.4) calc(var(--u)*5.4) calc(var(--u)*5.6);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;
  transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1),filter .8s ease;position:relative;z-index:2}
.slide.before .wrap{transform:translateX(calc(var(--u)*-7)) scale(.97);filter:blur(6px)}
.slide.after .wrap{transform:translateX(calc(var(--u)*7)) scale(1.03);filter:blur(6px)}
.deco{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;transition:transform 1.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1)}
.slide.before .deco{transform:translateX(calc(var(--u)*-22))}
.slide.after .deco{transform:translateX(calc(var(--u)*22))}
.deco>*{position:absolute}
.d-ring{border:1.5px solid var(--c);border-radius:50%;opacity:.28}
.d-dots{background-image:radial-gradient(var(--c) 1.4px,transparent 1.6px);background-size:calc(var(--u)*1.6) calc(var(--u)*1.6);opacity:.28;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 30%,transparent 72%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle,#000 30%,transparent 72%)}
.d-cross{color:var(--c);opacity:.4}
.d-blob{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--c),transparent 68%);opacity:.22;filter:blur(calc(var(--u)*1.2))}
.d-dia{border:1.5px solid var(--c);transform:rotate(45deg);opacity:.25}
.ghost{right:calc(var(--u)*3);bottom:calc(var(--u)*2);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:calc(var(--u)*13);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;white-space:nowrap;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.2px rgba(150,180,255,.10);text-transform:uppercase}

/* entrance animations (opacity stays 1 at rest, animation only plays while a slide is active) */
.slide.active .a{animation:rise .95s var(--ease) both;animation-delay:calc(.2s + var(--i,0)*.075s)}
.slide.active .a.l{animation-name:fromleft}
.slide.active .a.r{animation-name:fromright}
.slide.active .a.z{animation-name:zoom}
.slide.active .a.f{animation-name:fade}
.slide.active .a.g{animation-name:grow;transform-origin:left center}
.slide.active .a.gy{animation-name:growy;transform-origin:center bottom}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(calc(var(--u)*2.4)) scale(.985);filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
@keyframes fromleft{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(calc(var(--u)*-4));filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
@keyframes fromright{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(calc(var(--u)*4));filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
@keyframes zoom{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.8);filter:blur(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes grow{from{opacity:.2;transform:scaleX(0)}to{opacity:1;transform:scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes growy{from{opacity:.2;transform:scaleY(0)}to{opacity:1;transform:scaleY(1)}}

/* header */
.hdr{margin-bottom:calc(var(--u)*2.4);max-width:calc(var(--u)*82)}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7em;font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);
  padding:.45em 1.1em;border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.3);border-radius:99px;background:rgba(34,211,238,.07)}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:.55em;height:.55em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--cyan)}
h2.title{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-title);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:calc(var(--u)*1) 0 0;text-wrap:balance}
.sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-body);line-height:1.55;margin:calc(var(--u)*.8) 0 0;max-width:calc(var(--u)*60)}

/* cards */
.grid{display:grid;gap:calc(var(--u)*1.3)}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.2);padding:calc(var(--u)*1.6);min-width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.075),rgba(255,255,255,.02));border:1px solid var(--line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 calc(var(--u)*1.2) calc(var(--u)*3) rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  transition:scale .35s var(--ease),border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(var(--u)*.7)}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;
  background:radial-gradient(calc(var(--u)*20) circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 26%,transparent),transparent 62%)}
.card:hover{scale:1.015;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 55%,transparent);box-shadow:0 calc(var(--u)*1.6) calc(var(--u)*4) rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 0 calc(var(--u)*3) color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 18%,transparent)}
.card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.card>*{position:relative}
.card h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-h3);line-height:1.2;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.card p{margin:0;color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-body);line-height:1.5}
.ico{width:calc(var(--u)*3.4);height:calc(var(--u)*3.4);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*.95);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.7);color:var(--c,var(--blue));
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 15%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 38%,transparent);flex:none}
.hrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(var(--u)*1)}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em;font-size:var(--t-xs);padding:.45em 1.05em;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 45%,transparent);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,#3B82F6) 10%,transparent);color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;width:fit-content}
.pill b{font-weight:600;color:var(--c,var(--blue))}
.pill .ic{color:var(--c)}
.push{margin-top:auto}
ul.chk{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(var(--u)*.55)}
ul.chk li{display:flex;gap:.7em;align-items:flex-start;color:#C9D5F2;font-size:var(--t-sm);line-height:1.4}
ul.chk li .ic{color:var(--c,var(--cyan));margin-top:.18em;font-size:1.05em}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:calc(var(--u)*.4)}
.tags span{font-size:var(--t-xs);padding:.3em .7em;border-radius:calc(var(--u)*.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#B9C7EA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.flow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:calc(var(--u)*.3);align-items:center;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.flow li{font-size:max(10px,calc(var(--u)*.74));color:#CFE0FF;padding:.32em .7em;border-radius:calc(var(--u)*.5);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 13%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 30%,transparent)}
.flow li+li::before{content:"";}
.flow .ar{color:var(--c);font-size:var(--t-xs);opacity:.8}
.note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8em;color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-body);line-height:1.5;margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1.5)}
.note .ic{color:var(--cyan);font-size:1.4em}
.row-pills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:calc(var(--u)*1);margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1.3)}
.row-pills .pill{width:auto;justify-content:center;padding:.8em 1em;font-size:var(--t-sm)}

/* chevrons / process */
.chev-row{display:flex;gap:calc(var(--u)*.25)}
.chev{flex:1;position:relative;height:calc(var(--u)*4.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-sm);
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 88%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,#000));
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - var(--u)*1.4) 0,100% 50%,calc(100% - var(--u)*1.4) 100%,0 100%,var(--u)*1.4 50%);overflow:hidden;color:#fff}
.chev:first-child{clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - var(--u)*1.4) 0,100% 50%,calc(100% - var(--u)*1.4) 100%,0 100%)}
.chev::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.3) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-120%);animation:shine 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:calc(var(--k,0)*.35s)}
@keyframes shine{0%,55%{transform:translateX(-120%)}85%,100%{transform:translateX(120%)}}

/* cover */
.cover .wrap{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:calc(var(--u)*3);padding-top:calc(var(--u)*5)}
.cover .left{flex:1.25;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(var(--u)*2.2)}
.cover .right{flex:1;min-width:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
.wm{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1}
.wm b{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.07em;font-size:1em;color:#fff}
.wm b i{font-style:normal;font-weight:600;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7DD3FC,#2F6BFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.wm small{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:400;font-size:.27em;letter-spacing:.62em;margin-top:.7em;color:#C5D3F5}
.cover .wm{font-size:calc(var(--u)*4.2)}
.cover h1{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--u)*4.6);line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0;max-width:calc(var(--u)*52);text-wrap:balance;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff 0%,#BFD3FF 40%,#6EA8FF 60%,#fff 100%);background-size:220% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:shimmer 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes shimmer{from{background-position:0% 0}to{background-position:100% 0}}
.cover .lead{color:var(--mut);font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.25);line-height:1.55;margin:0;max-width:calc(var(--u)*44)}
.stats{display:flex;gap:0}
.stat{padding:0 calc(var(--u)*2.2);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat:first-child{padding-left:0;border-left:0}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--u)*3.2);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stat span{display:block;margin-top:.5em;color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.certs{display:flex;gap:calc(var(--u)*.8);flex-wrap:wrap}
.cert{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;font-size:var(--t-sm);font-weight:600;padding:.6em 1.1em;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid rgba(45,212,191,.4);background:rgba(45,212,191,.09);color:#CFFFF5}
.cert .ic{color:var(--teal);font-size:1.25em}
.orbit{--sz:calc(var(--u)*38);position:relative;width:var(--sz);height:var(--sz);max-width:100%}
.ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(140,170,255,.28);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:spin var(--sp,60s) linear infinite}
.ring.r1{width:calc(var(--sz)*.5);height:calc(var(--sz)*.5);--sp:40s}
.ring.r2{width:calc(var(--sz)*.76);height:calc(var(--sz)*.76);--sp:70s;animation-direction:reverse;border-style:solid;border-color:rgba(140,170,255,.14)}
.ring.r3{width:calc(var(--sz)*.99);height:calc(var(--sz)*.99);--sp:110s;border-color:rgba(140,170,255,.2)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes unspin{to{transform:rotate(-360deg)}}
.node{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:0;height:0;transform:rotate(var(--a))}
.node .pos{position:absolute;left:calc(var(--rr) * 1);top:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.node .n{width:calc(var(--u)*4.4);height:calc(var(--u)*4.4);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.2);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:calc(var(--u)*2);color:var(--c);
  background:rgba(8,16,46,.85);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--u)*2) color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 40%,transparent);
  animation:upright var(--sp,60s) linear infinite}
.node .n2{animation-name:upright2}
@keyframes upright{to{transform:rotate(-360deg)}}
@keyframes upright2{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.core{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:calc(var(--sz)*.28);height:calc(var(--sz)*.28);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#4F8BFF,#1B3FA8 70%);box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--u)*6) rgba(47,107,255,.75),inset 0 0 calc(var(--u)*2) rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--sz)*.13);color:#fff;animation:breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.core i{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B8F0FF,#fff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
@keyframes breathe{50%{box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--u)*9) rgba(47,107,255,.95),inset 0 0 calc(var(--u)*2) rgba(255,255,255,.3)}}

/* about / nebula */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.45fr 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*2);align-items:stretch}
.blk{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(var(--u)*.8);margin-bottom:calc(var(--u)*1.7)}
.lbl{font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.sol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:calc(var(--u)*.7)}
.sol .pill{width:auto;padding:.85em 1em;font-size:var(--t-sm);gap:.7em;border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1)}
.sol .pill .ic{font-size:1.5em}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:calc(var(--u)*.55)}
.chip{padding:.55em 1.15em;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:var(--t-sm);color:#D3DDF7;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}
.chip:hover{background:rgba(59,130,246,.2);border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.6)}
.neb{height:100%;justify-content:space-between;--c:var(--cyan);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(34,211,238,.12),rgba(59,130,246,.07) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.02))}
.neb .big{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--u)*3.4);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.neb .big sup{font-size:.4em;color:var(--cyan);vertical-align:top;position:relative;top:.4em}
.hexv{position:absolute!important;right:calc(var(--u)*-3);top:calc(var(--u)*-3);width:calc(var(--u)*16);height:calc(var(--u)*16);opacity:.55;color:var(--cyan)}
.hexv svg{width:100%;height:100%;animation:spin2 30s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin2{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.cstrip{margin-top:calc(var(--u)*.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:calc(var(--u)*2);flex-wrap:wrap;padding:calc(var(--u)*1.2) calc(var(--u)*1.8);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.2);
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(47,107,255,.3),rgba(139,92,246,.18));border:1px solid rgba(130,160,255,.3)}
.cstrip .t{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.25)}

/* architecture */
.arch{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(var(--u)*.9)}
.arch::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(var(--u)*7);top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--teal),var(--violet),var(--amber),var(--cyan));opacity:.5}
.arch::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(var(--u)*7 - 3px);width:8px;height:calc(var(--u)*5);border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#fff);box-shadow:0 0 14px #9cf;animation:pkt 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pkt{from{top:-6%;opacity:0}15%{opacity:1}85%{opacity:1}to{top:96%;opacity:0}}
.arow{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:calc(var(--u)*14) 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*1.2);align-items:stretch}
.alab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7em;padding:0 calc(var(--u)*1.2);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-h3);color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 85%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 50%,#000));box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--u)*2.5) color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 35%,transparent)}
.alab .ic{font-size:1.2em}
.anodes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:calc(var(--u)*.8)}
.anode{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;padding:calc(var(--u)*1.25) 0;border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 40%,transparent);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 9%,rgba(255,255,255,.02));font-size:var(--t-body);font-weight:500;transition:background .3s,scale .3s}
.anode:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 24%,transparent);scale:1.03}

/* marquee */
.marq-h{margin:calc(var(--u)*1.6) 0 calc(var(--u)*.8)}
.marquee{overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent)}
.track{display:flex;gap:calc(var(--u)*2);width:max-content;animation:scroll 46s linear infinite}
.marquee:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.lg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.55em;font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut)}
.lg i{width:calc(var(--u)*5);height:calc(var(--u)*5);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.2);background:#F2F6FF;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.lg img{width:calc(var(--u)*3.4);height:calc(var(--u)*3.4);object-fit:contain}
.tech .card{padding:calc(var(--u)*1.3);gap:calc(var(--u)*.6)}
.tech .ico{width:calc(var(--u)*2.8);height:calc(var(--u)*2.8);font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.4)}
.tech h3{font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.1)}

/* split layouts */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*2);align-items:center}
.map{border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.4);border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),rgba(255,255,255,.01));overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.map svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.mapcap{position:absolute;left:calc(var(--u)*1.2);bottom:calc(var(--u)*1);font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut)}
.stairs{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:calc(var(--u)*.8);height:calc(var(--u)*24)}
.step{flex:1;height:calc(var(--h)*1%);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1) calc(var(--u)*1) calc(var(--u)*.3) calc(var(--u)*.3);padding:calc(var(--u)*1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 70%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 18%,transparent));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 60%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--u)*2) color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 25%,transparent)}
.step .ic{font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.7);color:#fff}
.step span{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-sm);line-height:1.2}
.sjourney{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(var(--u)*1);margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1.5)}
.sjourney .pill{font-size:var(--t-sm);padding:.6em 1.3em}
.sjourney .line{flex:1;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c1),var(--c2));opacity:.6;position:relative}
.sjourney .line::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;top:-4px;width:8px;height:8px;border-top:2px solid var(--c2);border-right:2px solid var(--c2);transform:rotate(45deg)}

.split.s-a{grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;align-items:stretch}.split.s-b{grid-template-columns:1.35fr 1fr;align-items:stretch}
.split>*,.about>*,.uc>*{min-width:0}
/* gates */
.gates{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:calc(var(--u)*.9);margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1.4)}
.gate{padding:calc(var(--u)*1.2);gap:calc(var(--u)*.5)}
.gate .g{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em;font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c)}
.gate .g::before{content:"";width:.7em;height:.7em;background:var(--c);transform:rotate(45deg);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c)}
.gate h4{margin:0;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:calc(var(--u)*1);font-weight:600;line-height:1.25}
.gate ul.chk li{font-size:var(--t-xs)}

/* roadmap */
.gantt{position:relative;padding:calc(var(--u)*1.4);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.4);border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),rgba(255,255,255,.015));backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.gh,.gr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:calc(var(--u)*22) 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*1)}
.gq{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:calc(var(--u)*.3)}
.gq div{text-align:center;padding:.7em 0;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-sm);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*.6);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#CFE0FF}
.gr{margin-top:calc(var(--u)*.7);align-items:center}
.gl b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-body)}
.gl span{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-xs)}
.gt{position:relative;height:calc(var(--u)*3.4);border-radius:99px;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 calc(25% - 1px),rgba(160,185,255,.16) calc(25% - 1px) 25%);background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.gbar{position:absolute;top:calc(var(--u)*.35);bottom:calc(var(--u)*.35);left:calc(var(--l)*1%);width:calc(var(--w)*1%);border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 90%,#000),var(--c));box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--u)*2) color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,transparent);overflow:hidden}
.gbar::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-120%);animation:shine 5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:calc(var(--k,0)*.5s)}

/* use case chart */
.uc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*.8);align-items:stretch}
.uc .arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--cyan);font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.8)}
.uc .card{padding:calc(var(--u)*1.3);gap:calc(var(--u)*.5)}
.uc h3{font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.05);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c)}
.chartbox{margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1.1);padding:calc(var(--u)*.9) calc(var(--u)*1.4) calc(var(--u)*.6);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1.2);border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.chartbox svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.chartbox text{font-family:var(--fb);fill:#B9C7EA;font-size:11px}
.dr{stroke-dasharray:1;stroke-dashoffset:1}
.slide.active .dr{animation:draw 2.2s var(--ease) .9s forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
.slide.active .af{animation:fade 1.2s ease 1.8s both}

/* closing */
.steps3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*.8);align-items:stretch}
.steps3 .arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--cyan);font-size:calc(var(--u)*2)}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:calc(var(--u)*1.2);margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1.4)}
.contact .card{flex-direction:row;align-items:flex-start;gap:calc(var(--u)*1)}
.contact .card .ico{width:calc(var(--u)*2.8);height:calc(var(--u)*2.8);font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.4)}
.contact h3{font-size:calc(var(--u)*1)}
.contact p{font-size:var(--t-sm);color:#C9D5F2;user-select:text}
.contact a{text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.thanks{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--u)*5.2);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:calc(var(--u)*.9) 0 0;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff,#7DB0FF 60%,#22D3EE);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

/* HUD */
.hud{position:fixed;z-index:20;left:0;right:0;pointer-events:none;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.hud-top{top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:calc(var(--u)*1.6)}
.hud-top .wm{font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.7);transition:opacity .6s,transform .6s}
body[data-s="0"] .hud-top .wm{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}
.hud-bot{bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);padding-bottom:calc(var(--u)*1.5);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(var(--u)*1.4)}
.hud button{pointer-events:auto}
.btn{width:calc(var(--u)*3);height:calc(var(--u)*3);min-width:34px;min-height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.3);cursor:pointer;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:background .25s,scale .25s}
.btn:hover{background:rgba(59,130,246,.35);scale:1.08}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.btn:focus-visible,.seg:focus-visible,.mi:focus-visible,.chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px}
.prog{flex:1;display:flex;gap:calc(var(--u)*.35);pointer-events:auto}
.seg{flex:1;height:calc(var(--u)*.55);min-height:5px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s}
.seg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
.seg.done::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.seg:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.count{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--t-sm);color:var(--mut);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:5.5em;text-align:right}
.count b{color:var(--ink)}
.hud-r{display:flex;gap:calc(var(--u)*.7)}
.hint{position:fixed;z-index:21;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--u)*6);transform:translateX(-50%);padding:.8em 1.4em;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(10,19,48,.85);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);animation:hint 7s ease 1.5s both;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
@keyframes hint{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,10px)}10%,80%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,10px)}}
kbd{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:.9em;padding:.1em .5em;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--ink)}
.menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(4,8,24,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));overflow:auto}
.menu[hidden]{display:none}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:calc(var(--u)*1);width:calc(var(--u)*88);max-width:100%}
.mi{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4em;text-align:left;padding:calc(var(--u)*1.2);border-radius:calc(var(--u)*1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;font-size:var(--t-sm);transition:background .25s,border-color .25s}
.mi:hover,.mi.cur{background:rgba(59,130,246,.22);border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.7)}
.mi small{color:var(--dim);font-size:var(--t-xs);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* roomy slides: larger type where content is sparse */
.roomy{--t-title:max(24px,calc(var(--u)*3.1));--t-h3:max(15px,calc(var(--u)*1.55));--t-body:max(13px,calc(var(--u)*1.2));--t-sm:max(12px,calc(var(--u)*1.05));--t-xs:max(11px,calc(var(--u)*.88))}
.roomy .hdr{margin-bottom:calc(var(--u)*2.8)}
.roomy .grid{gap:calc(var(--u)*1.6)}
.roomy .card{padding:calc(var(--u)*2);gap:calc(var(--u)*.9)}
.roomy .ico{width:calc(var(--u)*4);height:calc(var(--u)*4);font-size:calc(var(--u)*2)}
.roomy .gate{padding:calc(var(--u)*1.3)}
.roomy .gate h4{font-size:calc(var(--u)*1.2)}
.roomy .chev{height:calc(var(--u)*5)}
.roomy .anode{padding:calc(var(--u)*1.7) 0}
.roomy .arch{gap:calc(var(--u)*1.1)}
.roomy .gt{height:calc(var(--u)*4.6)}
.roomy .gr{margin-top:calc(var(--u)*1)}
.roomy .stairs{height:calc(var(--u)*26)}
.roomy .row-pills .pill{padding:1em}
.roomy .contact .ico,.roomy .steps3 .ico{width:calc(var(--u)*3.6);height:calc(var(--u)*3.6)}
.roomy .uc .card,.roomy .contact .card{padding:calc(var(--u)*1.4)}
#s14 .hdr{margin-bottom:calc(var(--u)*1.6)}
#s14 .wrap{padding-top:calc(var(--u)*7)}
@media (max-width:900px){.roomy{--t-title:27px;--t-h3:17px;--t-body:14.5px;--t-sm:13.5px;--t-xs:12px}.roomy .card{padding:16px}.roomy .chev{height:42px}.roomy .ico{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:18px}.roomy .stairs{height:230px}.roomy .gt{height:30px}}
/* tablet and phone: slides scroll inside themselves */
@media (max-width:900px){
  .slide{overflow:hidden}
  :root{--u:9px;--t-title:27px;--t-h3:17px;--t-body:14.5px;--t-sm:13.5px;--t-xs:12px}
  body{overflow:hidden}
  .slide{overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
  .slide .wrap{width:100%;height:auto;min-height:100%;padding:70px 18px 90px;justify-content:flex-start}
  .split.s-a,.split.s-b{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .chev{flex:none}
  .chartbox .lbl+.lbl{display:none}
  .grid,.g2,.g3,.g4,.about,.split,.uc,.steps3,.contact,.sol,.gates,.row-pills,.anodes,.mgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .row-pills{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .anodes{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}
  .arow{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .alab{padding:12px 14px}
  .arch::before,.arch::after{display:none}
  .uc .arrow,.steps3 .arrow{transform:rotate(90deg)}
  .cover .wrap{flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:80px}
  .cover .wm{font-size:40px}.cover h1{font-size:34px}.cover .lead{font-size:15px}
  .cover .right{display:none}
  .stats{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:16px}.stat b{font-size:30px}.stat{padding:0 16px}
  .ghost{display:none}
  .chev-row{flex-direction:column}.chev{height:42px;clip-path:none!important;border-radius:10px}
  .gh,.gr{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gh>div:first-child{display:none}
  .gt{height:30px}
  .stairs{height:230px}
  .gates{gap:10px}
  .hud-bot .count{min-width:0}
  .hint{display:none}
  .thanks{font-size:44px}
  .hexv{display:none}
  .orbwrap{opacity:.8}
  .ico{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:18px}
  .card{padding:16px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
  .slide .wrap{filter:none!important}
  .dr{stroke-dashoffset:0!important}
}

<section class="slide  " data-title="About Inovix" data-ghost="About" aria-label="About Inovix"><div class="wrap"><div class="hdr" data-depth="0.5"><span class="eyebrow a">About Inovix Software Labs</span><h2 class="title a">Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</h2></div><div class="ab3" data-depth="0.3"><div class="card c-blue a"><h4>WHO WE ARE</h4><p class="l2">Inovix Software Labs is a technology engineering and innovation company delivering intelligent, secure and scalable digital solutions for businesses worldwide.</p><p>We combine Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering &amp; Analytics, Software Product Development, Cloud Technologies, Cybersecurity and Enterprise Integration to help organizations innovate, modernize and accelerate digital transformation.</p><p>Driven by engineering excellence and a security-first approach, we develop enterprise software products, intelligent automation solutions and customized technology platforms that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value.</p></div><div class="stack"><div class="card c-cyan a"><h4>OUR VISION</h4><p>To become a globally trusted technology and innovation partner, shaping a smarter, more connected and secure digital future through intelligent engineering.</p></div><div class="card c-teal a"><h4>OUR MISSION</h4><p>To empower businesses with innovative, intelligent and secure technology solutions by combining advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, data-driven insights and enterprise software expertise.</p><p>We strive to accelerate digital transformation, solve complex business challenges and create sustainable value through innovation, engineering excellence and trusted partnerships.</p></div></div><div class="band"><div class="card c-violet a"><h4>COMPLETE TECHNOLOGY LIFECYCLE</h4><p>Our capabilities span the complete technology lifecycle—from strategy and architecture to engineering, integration, deployment and ongoing optimization.</p></div><div class="card c-amber a"><p class="q">At Inovix, we engineer intelligence into technology and build security into its foundation—helping businesses innovate with confidence and prepare for the future.</p></div></div></div></div></section>

<div class="hud hud-top">
  <span class="wm"><b>INOVI<i>X</i></b><small>SOFTWARE LABS</small></span>
  <div class="hud-r">
    <button class="btn" id="menuBtn" type="button" aria-label="All slides (M)" title="All slides (M)"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-grid"/></svg></button>
    <button class="btn" id="fsBtn" type="button" aria-label="Fullscreen (F)" title="Fullscreen (F)"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-expand"/></svg></button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="hud hud-bot">
  <button class="btn" id="prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous slide"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-left"/></svg></button>
  <div class="prog" id="prog"></div>
  <span class="count" id="cnt"></span>
  <button class="btn" id="next" type="button" aria-label="Next slide"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-right"/></svg></button>
</div>
<div class="hint" aria-hidden="true">Use <kbd>&larr;</kbd> <kbd>&rarr;</kbd> or swipe to move. <kbd>M</kbd> shows all slides, <kbd>F</kbd> goes fullscreen.</div>
<div class="menu" id="menu" hidden><div class="mgrid" id="mgrid"></div></div>
<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
var slides=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.slide')),N=slides.length,cur=-1,lockT=0;
var body=document.body;
var reduce=window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function isSmall(){return innerWidth<=900}
function U(){return isSmall()?9:Math.min(innerWidth/100,innerHeight/56.25)}

/* stagger index for entrance animations */
slides.forEach(function(s){
  var k=0;
  [].forEach.call(s.querySelectorAll('.a'),function(el){
    el.style.setProperty('--i',Math.min(k++,16));
  });
});

/* decorative parallax layers, seeded per slide */
function rng(seed){var t=seed*9301+49297;return function(){t=(t*9301+49297)%233280;return t/233280}}
var cols=['var(--blue)','var(--cyan)','var(--violet)','var(--teal)','var(--amber)'];
var cross='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 3v18M3 12h18"/></svg>';
slides.forEach(function(s,i){
  var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='deco';
  var r=rng(i+3),h='';
  function px(a,b){return (a+(b-a)*r()).toFixed(1)}
  var defs=[
    ['d-ring',px(2,70),px(5,60),px(8,18),-3,'ring'],
    ['d-dots',px(55,92),px(8,50),px(10,16),4,'dots'],
    ['d-cross',px(60,95),px(60,90),px(2.2,3.4),6,'cross'],
    ['d-blob',px(0,55),px(50,90),px(14,26),-5,'blob'],
    ['d-dia',px(5,45),px(70,92),px(3,6),3,'dia'],
    ['d-cross',px(3,40),px(8,30),px(1.6,2.4),8,'cross']
  ];
  defs.forEach(function(df,k){
    var size=df[3],c=cols[(i+k)%cols.length];
    var st='left:'+df[1]+'%;top:'+df[2]+'%;width:calc(var(--u)*'+size+');height:calc(var(--u)*'+size+');--c:'+c+';';
    h+='<div class="'+df[0]+'" data-depth="'+df[4]+'" style="'+st+'">'+(df[5]==='cross'?cross:'')+'</div>';
  });
  var g=s.getAttribute('data-ghost');
  if(g)h+='<div class="ghost" data-depth="3">'+g+'</div>';
  d.innerHTML=h;
  s.insertBefore(d,s.firstChild);
});

/* tech logo marquee: duplicate for seamless loop */
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.track'),function(t){t.innerHTML+=t.innerHTML});

/* spotlight on cards */
document.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
  var c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.card');
  if(!c)return;
  var b=c.getBoundingClientRect();
  c.style.setProperty('--mx',((e.clientX-b.left)/b.width*100)+'%');
  c.style.setProperty('--my',((e.clientY-b.top)/b.height*100)+'%');
},{passive:true});

/* HUD */
var prog=document.getElementById('prog'),cnt=document.getElementById('cnt'),prev=document.getElementById('prev'),next=document.getElementById('next');
var segs=slides.map(function(s,i){
  var b=document.createElement('button');b.className='seg';b.type='button';
  b.title=(i+1)+'. '+s.getAttribute('data-title');b.setAttribute('aria-label','Go to slide '+(i+1)+': '+s.getAttribute('data-title'));
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){go(i)});prog.appendChild(b);return b;
});
var menu=document.getElementById('menu'),mgrid=document.getElementById('mgrid');
var mis=slides.map(function(s,i){
  var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='mi';
  b.innerHTML='<small>'+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')+'</small>'+s.getAttribute('data-title');
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){toggleMenu(false);go(i)});mgrid.appendChild(b);return b;
});
function toggleMenu(v){
  menu.hidden=!(v===undefined?menu.hidden:v);
  if(!menu.hidden){var c=mis[cur];if(c)c.focus()}
}
document.getElementById('menuBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){toggleMenu()});
menu.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===menu)toggleMenu(false)});
document.getElementById('fsBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  try{
    if(document.fullscreenElement){document.exitFullscreen()}
    else if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen){document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(function(){})}
  }catch(e){}
});
prev.addEventListener('click',function(){go(cur-1)});
next.addEventListener('click',function(){go(cur+1)});

/* background orbs: each slide moves them, giving cross-slide parallax */
var orbs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.orb'));
function moveOrbs(n){
  orbs.forEach(function(o,k){
    var x=50+Math.sin(n*1.1+k*2.1)*42, y=50+Math.cos(n*.9+k*1.7)*38;
    o.style.transform='translate('+(x*innerWidth/100)+'px,'+(y*innerHeight/100)+'px) scale('+(1+0.25*Math.sin(n+k))+')';
  });
}

/* counters */
function runCounters(s){
  [].forEach.call(s.querySelectorAll('[data-to]'),function(el){
    var to=+el.getAttribute('data-to'),t0=null,dur=1500;
    if(reduce){el.textContent=to;return}
    el.textContent='0';
    function f(ts){
      if(t0===null)t0=ts;
      var p=Math.min(1,(ts-t0-600)/dur);
      if(p<0){requestAnimationFrame(f);return}
      el.textContent=Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)));
      if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(f);
  });
}

var sweep=document.getElementById('sweep');
function go(n,silent){
  n=Math.max(0,Math.min(N-1,n));
  if(n===cur)return;
  var first=cur<0;cur=n;
  slides.forEach(function(s,j){
    s.classList.toggle('active',j===n);
    s.classList.toggle('before',j<n);
    s.classList.toggle('after',j>n);
    s.setAttribute('aria-hidden',j===n?'false':'true');
    if(j===n){s.scrollTop=0}
  });
  segs.forEach(function(b,j){b.classList.toggle('done',j<=n)});
  mis.forEach(function(b,j){b.classList.toggle('cur',j===n)});
  cnt.innerHTML='<b>'+String(n+1).padStart(2,'0')+'</b> / '+String(N).padStart(2,'0');
  prev.disabled=n===0;next.disabled=n===N-1;
  body.setAttribute('data-s',n);
  moveOrbs(n);
  runCounters(slides[n]);
  if(!first&&!reduce&&sweep){sweep.classList.remove('go');void sweep.offsetWidth;sweep.classList.add('go')}
  if(!silent){try{history.replaceState(null,'','#s'+(n+1))}catch(e){}}
}
function fromHash(){
  var m=/^#s(\d+)$/.exec(location.hash||'');
  return m?Math.max(0,Math.min(N-1,parseInt(m[1],10)-1)):0;
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',function(){go(fromHash(),true)});

/* input */
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey||e.altKey)return;
  var k=e.key;
  if(!menu.hidden){if(k==='Escape'||k==='m'||k==='M'){toggleMenu(false)}return}
  if(k==='ArrowRight'||k==='ArrowDown'||k==='PageDown'||k===' '||k==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();go(cur+1)}
  else if(k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='ArrowUp'||k==='PageUp'||k==='Backspace'){e.preventDefault();go(cur-1)}
  else if(k==='Home'){go(0)}
  else if(k==='End'){go(N-1)}
  else if(k==='f'||k==='F'){document.getElementById('fsBtn').click()}
  else if(k==='m'||k==='M'||k==='Escape'){toggleMenu(true)}
});
window.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){
  if(isSmall()||!menu.hidden)return;
  if(Math.abs(e.deltaY)<28&&Math.abs(e.deltaX)<28)return;
  var now=Date.now();if(now-lockT<950)return;lockT=now;
  go(cur+((e.deltaY||e.deltaX)>0?1:-1));
},{passive:true});
var tx=0,ty=0;
window.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){tx=e.touches[0].clientX;ty=e.touches[0].clientY},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){
  var dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-tx,dy=e.changedTouches[0].clientY-ty;
  if(Math.abs(dx)>60&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.4){go(cur+(dx<0?1:-1))}
},{passive:true});

/* mouse parallax: decorative layers and a few content groups use the `translate` property */
var mx=0,my=0,cx=0,cy=0;
window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
  mx=(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*2;my=(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*2;
},{passive:true});

/* particle constellation */
var cv=document.getElementById('bg'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),W=0,H=0,dpr=1,P=[];
function resize(){
  dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  var n=Math.round(Math.min(110,Math.max(36,W*H/16000)));
  P=[];var r=rng(7);
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++)P.push({x:r()*W,y:r()*H,vx:(r()-.5)*.25,vy:(r()-.5)*.25,s:.7+r()*1.6,z:.3+r()*1.2,h:r()});
  if(cur>=0)moveOrbs(cur);
}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
var px=0,py=0,running=true;
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  var ox=-cur*34,link=Math.min(150,W/9);
  for(var i=0;i<P.length;i++){
    var p=P[i];
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
    if(p.x<-20)p.x=W+20;if(p.x>W+20)p.x=-20;if(p.y<-20)p.y=H+20;if(p.y>H+20)p.y=-20;
    p.dx=((p.x+ox*p.z+cx*14*p.z)%(W+40)+(W+40))%(W+40)-20;
    p.dy=p.y+cy*10*p.z;
  }
  for(i=0;i<P.length;i++){
    var a=P[i];
    for(var j=i+1;j<P.length;j++){
      var b=P[j],dx=a.dx-b.dx,dy=a.dy-b.dy,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
      if(d<link*link){
        var al=(1-Math.sqrt(d)/link)*.28;
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,170,255,'+al+')';ctx.lineWidth=1;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.dx,a.dy);ctx.lineTo(b.dx,b.dy);ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    var mxp=(cx*.5+.5)*W,myp=(cy*.5+.5)*H,ddx=a.dx-mxp,ddy=a.dy-myp,dm=Math.sqrt(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy);
    if(dm<170){
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(34,211,238,'+(1-dm/170)*.35+')';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.dx,a.dy);ctx.lineTo(mxp,myp);ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle=a.h>.8?'rgba(34,211,238,.9)':a.h>.55?'rgba(155,123,255,.8)':'rgba(160,195,255,.75)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.dx,a.dy,a.s,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  }
}
function parallax(){
  cx+=(mx-cx)*.07;cy+=(my-cy)*.07;
  var u=U();
  var act=slides[cur];
  if(act){
    [].forEach.call(act.querySelectorAll('[data-depth]'),function(el){
      var d=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-depth'))*u;
      el.style.translate=(-cx*d).toFixed(2)+'px '+(-cy*d).toFixed(2)+'px';
    });
  }
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.orbp'),function(el,k){
    var d=(2+k*1.5)*u;el.style.translate=(cx*d).toFixed(1)+'px '+(cy*d).toFixed(1)+'px';
  });
}
function loop(){
  if(!running)return;
  parallax();draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
  running=!document.hidden;if(running)requestAnimationFrame(loop);
});
resize();
go(fromHash(),true);
if(reduce){draw()}else{requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
window.__deck={go:go,count:N};
})();

</script>

</body></html>

:root[data-theme=dark]{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#050A1C;--bg2:#0A1330;--ink:#EAF0FF;--mut:#9DABD0;--dim:#7080A8;--line:rgba(160,185,255,.16);--glass:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.075),rgba(255,255,255,.02));--surf:rgba(255,255,255,.05);--shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45);--accent:#5B9BFF;--on:#fff;--orb:.5}

*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:5rem}
body{margin:0;font:var(--t-body)/1.6 var(--fb);color:var(--ink);background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 15% 0,var(--bg2),transparent 60%),var(--bg);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-20% -10% auto auto;width:50vw;height:50vw;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--blue),transparent 65%);filter:blur(80px);opacity:var(--orb);pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--fd);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;line-height:1.15}
