a{color:var(--accent)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
/* shell */
header.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.7rem clamp(1rem,3vw,2rem);padding-top:calc(.7rem + env(safe-area-inset-top));background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 70%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.logo{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}
.logo i{width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan));box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(59,130,246,.6)}
.logo small{font:500 var(--t-xs)/1 var(--fb);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mut);display:block;margin-top:2px}
.sp{flex:1}
.wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:15rem 1fr;max-width:90rem;margin:auto}
nav.side{position:sticky;top:4rem;align-self:start;height:calc(100vh - 4rem);overflow:auto;padding:1.5rem 1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem}
nav.side a{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;padding:.5rem .75rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none;font-size:var(--t-sm);font-weight:500;transition:.2s}
nav.side a:hover,nav.side a.on{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 16%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
nav.side a.on{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--blue)}
main{padding:2rem clamp(1rem,4vw,3rem) 5rem;min-width:0}
.hero{padding:2rem 0 1rem}.hero h1{font-size:var(--t-h1);max-width:16ch}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan),var(--violet));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p{color:var(--mut);max-width:60ch;font-size:1.05rem}
section{margin-top:3.5rem}section>h2{font-size:var(--t-h2);margin-bottom:.35rem}section>p{color:var(--mut);margin:0 0 1.25rem}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);padding:.4rem 1rem;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 35%,transparent);border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 8%,transparent);margin-bottom:1rem}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:.5rem;height:.5rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--cyan)}
.demo{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.5rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-3);align-items:center;margin-bottom:var(--space-4)}
.demo.col{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(16rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4)}
.lbl{width:100%;font-size:var(--t-xs);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);font-weight:600}
/* buttons */
.btn{--c:var(--blue);--cc:#fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;font:600 .9rem/1 var(--fb);padding:.8rem 1.2rem;min-height:2.75rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--cc);background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 88%,#fff),var(--c));box-shadow:0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 38%,transparent),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);transition:transform .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s,filter .2s;text-decoration:none}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.08);box-shadow:0 12px 28px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 50%,transparent),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.98)}
.btn:disabled,.btn.dis{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;filter:none;box-shadow:none}
.b-primary{--c:var(--blue)}.b-secondary{--c:#64748B}.b-success{--c:var(--green)}.b-danger{--c:var(--red)}.b-warning{--c:var(--yellow);--cc:#2A1E00}.b-info{--c:var(--cyan);--cc:#04222B}.b-violet{--c:var(--violet)}.b-dark{--c:#1E2A4A}
.b-light{--c:#EAF0FF;--cc:#0B1633}
.o{background:transparent;color:var(--c);border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:none}.o:hover{background:var(--c);color:var(--cc);box-shadow:0 8px 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 40%,transparent)}
.s{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 15%,transparent);color:var(--c);box-shadow:none;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 25%,transparent)}.s:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 26%,transparent)}
.gh{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:none}.gh:hover{background:var(--surf);box-shadow:none}
[data-theme=light] .b-warning.o,[data-theme=light] .b-warning.s,[data-theme=light] .b-info.o,[data-theme=light] .b-info.s{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,#000)}
.sm{padding:.55rem .9rem;min-height:2.25rem;font-size:.8rem}.lg{padding:1rem 1.6rem;min-height:3.25rem;font-size:1rem}
.ib{padding:0;width:2.75rem}.pill{border-radius:99px}
.glow{animation:glow 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes glow{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 0%,transparent),0 0 30px var(--c)}}
.spin{width:1em;height:1em;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;animation:rot .7s linear infinite}@keyframes rot{to{rotate:360deg}}
.grp{display:inline-flex}.grp .btn{border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}.grp .btn:first-child{border-radius:var(--r-md) 0 0 var(--r-md)}.grp .btn:last-child{border-radius:0 var(--r-md) var(--r-md) 0}.grp .btn+.btn{margin-left:-1px}
/* swatches */
.sw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(8.5rem,1fr));gap:.75rem;width:100%}
.sw div{border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:2.6rem .8rem .7rem;font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35);border:1px solid var(--line)}.sw span{display:block;font-weight:400;opacity:.85}
/* forms */
.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;min-width:14rem;flex:1}.f label{font-size:var(--t-sm);font-weight:600}.f label em{color:var(--red);font-style:normal}
.in{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.75rem 1rem;min-height:3rem;width:100%;transition:.2s}
.in::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}.in:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 50%,var(--line))}
.in:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 25%,transparent)}
.in.bad{border-color:var(--red)}.in.ok{border-color:var(--green)}.in:disabled{opacity:.45}
select.in{appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--mut) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mut) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 1.3rem) 55%,calc(100% - 1rem) 55%;background-size:6px 6px;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.hint{font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--dim)}.hint.bad{color:var(--red)}.hint.ok{color:var(--green)}
.chk{display:inline-flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:var(--t-sm)}.chk input{appearance:none;width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;border:1.5px solid var(--dim);border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-content:center;margin:0;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.chk input[type=radio]{border-radius:50%}.chk input::before{content:"";width:.6rem;height:.6rem;transform:scale(0);transition:.15s;background:#fff;clip-path:polygon(14% 44%,0 65%,50% 100%,100% 16%,80% 0,43% 62%)}
.chk input[type=radio]::before{clip-path:circle(50%);width:.45rem;height:.45rem}.chk input:checked{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue)}.chk input:checked::before{transform:scale(1)}
.sw-t{appearance:none;width:2.8rem;height:1.6rem;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s;margin:0}.sw-t::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:2px auto 2px 2px;width:1.2rem;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:.25s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.sw-t:checked{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan))}.sw-t:checked::after{translate:1.2rem}
input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--blue);width:100%}
/* badges */
.bd{--c:var(--blue);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;padding:.3rem .75rem;border-radius:99px;color:var(--c);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 13%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 35%,transparent)}
.bd.dot::before{content:"";width:.45rem;height:.45rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--c)}.bd.solid{background:var(--c);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.c-green{--c:var(--green)}.c-red{--c:var(--red)}.c-yel{--c:var(--yellow)}.c-cyan{--c:var(--cyan)}.c-vio{--c:var(--violet)}.c-teal{--c:var(--teal)}.c-org{--c:var(--orange)}
/* alerts */
.al{--c:var(--blue);display:flex;gap:.8rem;padding:1rem 1.1rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 11%,var(--bg));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 35%,transparent);border-left:4px solid var(--c);width:100%}
.al .ic{color:var(--c);margin-top:.15rem}.al b{display:block}.al span{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm)}.al button{margin-left:auto;background:0;border:0;color:var(--mut);cursor:pointer}
/* cards */
.card{--c:var(--blue);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.4rem;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:.3s var(--ease);flex:1;min-width:14rem}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(18rem circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0),color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 22%,transparent),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:.3s;pointer-events:none}
.card:hover{translate:0 -4px;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,transparent)}.card:hover::before{opacity:1}.card>*{position:relative}
.card h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin:.9rem 0 .35rem}.card p{margin:0;color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.ico{width:2.8rem;height:2.8rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--c);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 14%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 30%,transparent);font-size:1.3rem}
.stat b{font:700 2rem var(--fd);display:block}.up{color:var(--green);font-size:var(--t-sm);font-weight:600}
/* tabs, crumbs, pagination, steps */
.tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:.25rem;padding:.3rem;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md)}.tabs button{font:500 var(--t-sm) var(--fb);color:var(--mut);background:0;border:0;padding:.55rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(59,130,246,.45)}.panel{padding:1rem .25rem;color:var(--mut);width:100%}
.crumbs{display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;font-size:var(--t-sm);color:var(--mut)}.crumbs a{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none}.crumbs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}.crumbs b{color:var(--ink)}
.pg{display:flex;gap:.3rem}.pg button{min-width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font:500 var(--t-sm) var(--fb)}.pg button.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.steps{display:flex;width:100%;gap:.5rem}.st{flex:1;font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--dim);text-align:center}.st::before{content:attr(data-n);display:grid;place-items:center;width:2rem;height:2rem;margin:0 auto .4rem;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.st.done{color:var(--ink)}.st.done::before{content:"✓";background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}.st.cur{color:var(--ink)}.st.cur::before{border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 25%,transparent)}
/* progress, avatar, skeleton */
.bar{height:.6rem;width:100%;background:var(--surf);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:var(--v);border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c,var(--blue)),var(--cyan));transition:width 1s var(--ease)}
.av{width:2.75rem;height:2.75rem;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 .85rem var(--fd);color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--violet));border:2px solid var(--bg);position:relative}.av+.av{margin-left:-.7rem}.av.on::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:.75rem;height:.75rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);border:2px solid var(--bg)}
.sk{border-radius:var(--r-sm);height:1rem;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--surf) 25%,var(--line) 50%,var(--surf) 75%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:sh 1.4s infinite}@keyframes sh{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
/* table */
.tw{overflow-x:auto;width:100%}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:var(--t-sm);min-width:30rem}th{text-align:left;color:var(--dim);font-size:var(--t-xs);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:.7rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}td{padding:.85rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}tbody tr{transition:.2s}tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surf)}
/* accordion, tooltip, dropdown, modal, toast, drawer */
details{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surf);padding:.9rem 1.1rem}details+details{margin-top:-.25rem}summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}summary::after{content:"+";color:var(--cyan);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1;transition:.2s}details[open] summary::after{rotate:45deg}details p{color:var(--mut);margin:.6rem 0 0}
.tip{position:relative}.tip::after{content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;translate:-50% 4px;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:#0B1633;color:#EAF0FF;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:var(--t-xs);white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .28s var(--ease),translate .32s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.tip:hover::after,.tip:focus-visible::after{opacity:1;translate:-50% 0}
.tip.tip-below::after{top:calc(100% + 8px);bottom:auto;translate:-50% -4px}
.tip.tip-below:hover::after,.tip.tip-below:focus-visible::after{translate:-50% 0}
.tip.tip-left::after{left:auto;right:0;translate:0 4px}
.tip.tip-left:hover::after,.tip.tip-left:focus-visible::after{translate:0 0}
.tip.tip-left.tip-below::after{translate:0 -4px}
.tip.tip-left.tip-below:hover::after,.tip.tip-left.tip-below:focus-visible::after{translate:0 0}
.dd{position:relative}.menu{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + .5rem);left:0;min-width:13rem;padding:.4rem;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:5;display:none}.menu.open{display:block;animation:rise .25s var(--ease)}
.menu a{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;padding:.55rem .7rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-size:var(--t-sm)}.menu a:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 18%,transparent)}.menu a.d{color:var(--red)}
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(2,6,20,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:none;place-items:center;padding:1rem}.scrim.open{display:grid;animation:fade .25s}
.modal{width:min(30rem,100%);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.5rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:rise .35s var(--ease)}.modal header{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.8rem}.modal h3{flex:1}.modal footer{display:flex;gap:.6rem;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:1.4rem}
.drawer{place-items:stretch end;padding:0}.drawer .modal{height:100%;width:min(24rem,100%);border-radius:var(--r-lg) 0 0 var(--r-lg);animation:slide .4s var(--ease)}@keyframes slide{from{translate:100%}}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;translate:0 12px}}@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}}
.toasts{position:fixed;right:1rem;bottom:calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:60;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}.toast{--c:var(--blue);display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;padding:.8rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--c);box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:rise .35s var(--ease);min-width:15rem}.toast .ic{color:var(--c)}
.code{font:.8rem/1.6 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:1rem;overflow:auto;width:100%;color:var(--mut)}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:2rem;width:100%}.empty .ico{margin:0 auto 1rem;width:4rem;height:4rem;--c:var(--violet)}.empty p{color:var(--mut)}
.tl{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid var(--line);width:100%}.tl li{position:relative;padding:0 0 1.2rem 1rem}.tl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.7rem;top:.35rem;width:.75rem;height:.75rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c,var(--blue));box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c,var(--blue))}.tl small{color:var(--dim)}
footer.pg-f{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:2rem;text-align:center;color:var(--dim);font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.hb{display:grid;gap:5px;place-content:center;width:2.75rem;height:2.75rem;background:0;border:0;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--r-md);transition:background-color .3s var(--ease-decelerate)}.hb:hover{background:var(--surf)}
.hb i{display:block;width:1.3rem;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ink);transition:translate .44s var(--ease-decelerate),rotate .44s var(--ease-decelerate),scale .38s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .26s var(--ease)}
.hb i:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.02s}.hb i:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.05s}.hb i:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.08s}
.hb[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.08s}.hb[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.04s}.hb[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(3){transition-delay:0s}
.hb[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(1){translate:0 7px;rotate:45deg}.hb[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(2){opacity:0;scale:0}.hb[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(3){translate:0 -7px;rotate:-45deg}
.wrap{transition:grid-template-columns .44s var(--ease-decelerate)}
nav.side{transition:translate .44s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .32s var(--ease),padding .44s var(--ease-decelerate),visibility 0s linear .44s}
.wrap:not(.closed) nav.side{translate:0 0;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:translate .44s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .32s var(--ease),padding .44s var(--ease-decelerate),visibility 0s}
.wrap.closed{grid-template-columns:0 1fr}.wrap.closed nav.side{visibility:hidden;opacity:0;translate:-14px 0;padding:0}
.ch{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}.ch text{fill:var(--dim);font:10px var(--fb)}.ch .gl{stroke:var(--line)}.hm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:3px;width:100%}.hm i{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:4px;background:var(--blue)}
.fn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;width:100%}.fn div{height:2.2rem;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:var(--t-xs);font-weight:600;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--cyan))}
@media(max-width:860px){.wrap,.wrap.closed{display:block}nav.side,.wrap.closed nav.side{position:fixed;top:4rem;left:0;right:auto;bottom:auto;z-index:15;width:16rem;height:calc(100vh - 4rem);height:calc(100dvh - 4rem);max-height:calc(100dvh - 4rem);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:var(--bg2);border-right:1px solid var(--line);translate:-100%;transition:translate .44s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .44s;visibility:visible;opacity:1;padding:1.5rem 1rem}.wrap.open nav.side{translate:0;box-shadow:var(--shadow);visibility:visible;opacity:1;transition:translate .44s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s var(--ease),visibility 0s}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}


/* ===== Extensions: brand lockup, token reference, enterprise, deck bridge ===== */
.lock{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;font-family:'DejaVu Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:400}
.lock .w{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.6vw,1.4rem);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.lock .d{font-size:max(10px,clamp(.58rem,.75vw,.7rem));letter-spacing:.4em;margin-top:3px}
.lock .t{font-size:max(10px,clamp(.55rem,.7vw,.66rem));letter-spacing:.01em;margin-top:3px}
.lock.navy{color:#FFFFFF}.lock.light{color:#03182D}
a.brand-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-width:2.75rem;min-height:2.75rem;text-decoration:none;border-radius:var(--r-md)}
a.brand-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px}
.syschip{font:600 var(--t-xs)/1 var(--fb);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);padding:.45rem .7rem;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.logo-spec{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-4);align-items:stretch;margin-bottom:var(--space-4)}
.logo-spec>div{flex:1;min-width:15rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.4rem;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:9rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.logo-spec .on-navy{background:#03182D}.logo-spec .on-white{background:#FFFFFF}.logo-spec .on-deck{background:#050A1C}
.lock-demo,.lock-demo .w{font-size:1.6rem}.lock-demo .d,.lock-demo .t{font-size:.62rem}
.lock-clear{padding:1.6em;background:#03182D;border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.35);display:inline-block;border-radius:var(--r-md)}

.sechead{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1rem}
.sechead h2{margin:0}.sechead p{margin:.25rem 0 0;color:var(--mut);max-width:70ch}
.sechead .tag{font:600 var(--t-xs)/1 var(--fb);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 35%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 8%,transparent);padding:.45rem .75rem;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.lead{font-size:1.02rem;color:var(--mut);max-width:75ch;line-height:1.65}
.promptbar{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 35%,transparent);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.8rem 1rem;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.promptbar code{flex:1;min-width:16rem;font:.85rem/1.5 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:var(--ink);user-select:all;word-break:break-word}
.copy-btn{flex:none}

.tv{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;background:var(--surf);margin:.75rem 0 1.25rem}
.tv table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:0;font-size:var(--t-sm);margin:0}
.tv th{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 14%,var(--bg2));color:var(--ink);font-size:var(--t-xs);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left;padding:.6rem .8rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tv td{padding:.55rem .8rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);vertical-align:top}
.tv tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.tv code{font:.78rem/1.4 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:var(--cyan);white-space:nowrap}
.tv .num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)}
.hscroll{overflow:auto;border-radius:var(--r-md)}
/* Rule 10 / 28: the header stays brand navy with a white text-only lockup in BOTH themes. */
* { scrollbar-width:thin; scrollbar-color:var(--scrollbar-thumb) var(--scrollbar-track) }
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:var(--scrollbar-width);height:var(--scrollbar-width)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--scrollbar-track)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--scrollbar-thumb);border-radius:99px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--scrollbar-thumb-hover)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-corner{background:var(--scrollbar-corner)}
header.top{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#03182D,#041B33)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #143656!important;color:#FFFFFF!important}
header.top .syschip{color:#CFE3FF;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
header.top .bd{color:#BFF6D8;border-color:rgba(45,212,191,.42);background:rgba(45,212,191,.12)}
header.top .hb i{background:#FFFFFF}
header.top .btn.gh{color:#FFFFFF}
header.top .btn.gh:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
header.top a.brand-link{color:#FFFFFF}
.sw-line{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-2);margin:var(--space-3) 0 var(--space-4)}
.sw-line i{height:2.1rem;min-width:2.1rem;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 .58rem/1 var(--fb);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);font-style:normal;padding:0 .4rem}

.bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(15rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.bento .card{min-width:0}
.span2{grid-column:span 2}
@media(max-width:860px){.span2{grid-column:span 1}}
.card.small{padding:1rem;min-width:0}
.card h4{margin:.6rem 0 .35rem;font:600 1rem var(--fd);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.muted{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.mini{font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:600}
.row{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.between{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem;width:100%}
.divider{height:1px;background:var(--line);width:100%;margin:.5rem 0}

.org{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:1rem 0;overflow-x:auto}
.org>ul{list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.5rem 0 0;margin:0;position:relative;min-width:24rem;width:100%}
.org>ul::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;height:1.5rem;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.org>ul::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:1.5rem;left:16.66%;right:16.66%;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.org li{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:1.5rem .35rem 0;min-width:5.6rem}
.org li::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;height:1.5rem;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.org .node{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.55rem .7rem;display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem;font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.org .node small{color:var(--dim);font-size:var(--t-xs)}
.kanban{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(11rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.4rem}
.kanban .col{background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.7rem;min-height:9rem}
.kanban .task{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:.6rem;margin-top:.5rem;font-size:var(--t-sm);cursor:grab;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.kanban .task:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 50%,transparent)}
.rbac{overflow:auto;width:100%}.rbac table{min-width:32rem}
.rbac td.g{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}.rbac td.n{color:var(--dim)}
.cmdbox{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;width:100%;max-width:34rem}
.cmdbox .cin{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;padding:.9rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.cmdbox ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:.4rem}
.cmdbox li{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;padding:.6rem .7rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);font-size:var(--t-sm);cursor:pointer}
.cmdbox li:hover,.cmdbox li.sel{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 18%,transparent)}
.cmdbox li span:last-child{margin-left:auto;color:var(--dim);font-size:var(--t-xs)}
.cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:4px;width:100%;font-size:var(--t-xs)}
.cal b{aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surf);font-weight:500;color:var(--mut)}
.cal b.h{background:none;border-color:transparent;color:var(--dim)}
.cal b.today{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 25%,transparent)}
.cal b.evt{color:var(--cyan);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 50%,transparent)}
.qb{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;width:100%;font-size:var(--t-sm)}
.qb .tok{padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--violet) 17%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--violet) 40%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
.qb .op{padding:.4rem .6rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut)}
.filegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(6.5rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.filegrid div{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.9rem .6rem;text-align:center;font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut);transition:.2s var(--ease)}
.filegrid div:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 45%,transparent)}
.filegrid b{display:block;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:.35rem}

.state-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(11rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.state-grid div{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.7rem;font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut)}
.state-grid b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:var(--t-sm);margin-bottom:.25rem}
.micogrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(13rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.micogrid>div{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.4rem;min-height:7.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
.micogrid>div:hover{translate:0 -3px;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 45%,transparent)}
.micogrid b{font:600 .9rem var(--fd)}
.micogrid small{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-xs);line-height:1.45}
.micogrid .demoline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-top:auto}
.dotp{width:.6rem;height:.6rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 22%,transparent)}
.grip{width:1.4rem;height:1.4rem;background-image:radial-gradient(currentColor 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:5px 5px;color:var(--dim);opacity:.8}


/* ===== Complete component gallery ===== */

/* ===== Implementation library: one live, described card per component ===== */
.impl-tools{display:flex;gap:var(--space-4);align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;margin-bottom:var(--space-4)}
.impl-tools input{flex:1;min-width:16rem}
.impl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(17rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.impl-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-3);padding:var(--space-4);background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);min-width:0;transition:transform .3s var(--ease-decelerate),border-color .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease)}
.impl-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--blue)) 55%,transparent)}
.impl-card.hide-nav{display:none}
.impl-head{display:flex;gap:var(--space-2);align-items:center}
.impl-head::before{content:"";width:.5rem;height:.5rem;border-radius:3px;background:var(--c,var(--blue));flex:none}
.impl-head b{font:600 var(--t-sm)/1.3 var(--fd);color:var(--ink);word-break:break-word}
.impl-head span{margin-left:auto;font:600 var(--t-xs) var(--fb);color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap}
.impl-desc{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-xs);line-height:1.55;margin:0}
.impl-demo{min-height:3.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--space-3);flex-wrap:wrap;padding:var(--space-3);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surf);overflow:visible}
.impl-meta{font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--dim);line-height:1.45;margin:0;padding-top:var(--space-2);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.impl-svg{width:100%;max-width:10rem;height:3rem;display:block}
.impl-svg .g{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1}
.impl-graph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--space-2);width:100%}
.impl-graph i{width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem;border-radius:6px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--blue)) 18%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--blue)) 50%,transparent);display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:.6rem;color:var(--ink)}
.impl-graph u{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line);text-decoration:none}
.impl-map{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:4px;width:100%;max-width:9rem}
.impl-map i{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:3px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--blue)) 22%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.impl-map i.on{background:var(--c,var(--blue));box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--c,var(--blue))}
.impl-code{font:.68rem/1.5 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:var(--cyan);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:var(--space-2);margin:0;width:100%;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;overflow:visible}
.impl-mini-page{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;width:100%;font-size:var(--t-xs);background:var(--bg2)}
.impl-mini-page b{display:block;padding:.35rem .5rem;background:var(--surf);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
.impl-mini-page span{display:block;padding:.45rem .5rem;color:var(--mut)}
.impl-section-link{display:inline-block;margin-left:var(--space-3);color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.impl-section-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.impl-mini-lock{font-family:'DejaVu Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.1}
.impl-mini-lock small{display:block;font-size:.42rem;letter-spacing:.15em}
.nav-group-toggle{display:flex;width:100%;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:0;border:0;color:var(--cyan);font:600 var(--t-xs)/1 var(--fb);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .25rem;cursor:pointer}
.nav-group-toggle::after{content:"+";font-size:1rem}
.nav-group-toggle[aria-expanded=true]::after{content:"−"}
.nav-sub{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.nav-sub[hidden]{display:none}

.demo-panel{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .38s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .3s var(--ease);opacity:0;width:100%}
.demo-panel.open{max-height:12rem;opacity:1;padding-top:.7rem}
.skip-link{position:fixed;top:-4rem;left:1rem;z-index:120;padding:.7rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--blue);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font:600 var(--t-sm) var(--fb);transition:top .25s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.skip-link:focus{top:1rem}
.hb-demo{display:grid;gap:5px;place-content:center;width:2.75rem;height:2.75rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surf);cursor:pointer}
.hb-demo i{display:block;width:1.2rem;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ink);transition:translate .4s var(--ease-decelerate),rotate .4s var(--ease-decelerate),opacity .25s}
.hb-demo[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(1){translate:0 7px;rotate:45deg}.hb-demo[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(2){opacity:0}.hb-demo[aria-expanded=true] i:nth-child(3){translate:0 -7px;rotate:-45deg}
.ios{appearance:none;width:3.1rem;height:1.8rem;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--dim) 55%,var(--surf));border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .35s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.ios::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:1.45rem;height:1.45rem;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:translate .36s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.ios:checked{background:#34C759;border-color:#34C759}.ios:checked::after{translate:1.28rem 0}
.ios:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
input.ios{appearance:none;width:3.1rem;height:1.8rem;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--dim) 55%,var(--surf));border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .35s var(--ease-decelerate)}
input.ios::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:1.45rem;height:1.45rem;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:translate .36s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.chk input.ios:checked,.ios:checked{background:#34C759;border-color:#34C759}
.chk input.ios:checked::after,.ios:checked::after{translate:1.28rem 0}
.chk input.ios:disabled,.ios:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.chk input.ios::before,.chk input.sw-t::before,.chk input.ios:checked::before,.chk input.sw-t:checked::before{display:none!important;content:none!important}
.chk input.sw-t,.sw-t{appearance:none;width:3.1rem;height:1.8rem;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--dim) 55%,var(--surf));border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .35s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.sw-t::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:1.45rem;height:1.45rem;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:translate .36s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.chk input.sw-t:checked,.sw-t:checked{background:#34C759;border-color:#34C759}
.chk input.sw-t:checked::after,.sw-t:checked::after{translate:1.28rem 0}
.chk input.sw-t:disabled,.sw-t:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.combo{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:20rem}
.combo-list{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + .3rem);left:0;right:0;z-index:5;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:.35rem;list-style:none;margin:0}
.combo-list li{padding:.5rem .6rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);font-size:var(--t-sm);cursor:pointer;color:var(--mut)}
.combo-list li:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 18%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
.combo-list li.hide-nav{display:none}
.media-box{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;background:#000}
.media-box audio,.media-box video{width:100%;display:block}
.player-art{aspect-ratio:16/9;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(100% 80% at 30% 0,#123,transparent 60%),#050A1C;color:#EAF0FF;font:600 1.1rem var(--fd)}
.tabseq{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%}
.tabseq span{padding:.6rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--surf);font-size:var(--t-sm);color:var(--mut)}
.tabseq span:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px;color:var(--ink)}
.rtlbox{direction:rtl;text-align:right;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.8rem;background:var(--surf);font-size:var(--t-sm);color:var(--ink);width:100%}
.locale-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(9rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-3);width:100%}
.locale-grid div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:.6rem;background:var(--surf);font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut)}
.locale-grid b{display:block;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:.25rem}
.type-spec{width:100%}
.type-spec div{padding:.35rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut)}
.type-spec b{color:var(--ink)}
.elev-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.elev-row div{min-width:7rem;padding:1rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut)}

.menu-search{position:relative;width:100%;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.global-search{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;width:clamp(12rem,22vw,21rem)}
.global-search .ic{position:absolute;left:.8rem;color:var(--dim);pointer-events:none;font-size:1rem}
.global-search input{padding-left:2.5rem;padding-right:2.2rem;min-height:2.6rem;font-size:var(--t-sm);background:var(--surf)}
.global-search kbd{position:absolute;right:.6rem;font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--dim);pointer-events:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surf);padding:.05rem .35rem;border-radius:4px}
.page-results{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + .55rem);right:0;width:min(28rem,88vw);max-height:60vh;overflow:auto;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:40;padding:.4rem}
.page-results button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:0;border:0;color:var(--ink);padding:.6rem .7rem;border-radius:var(--r-sm);cursor:pointer;font:inherit}
.page-results button:hover,.page-results button.sel{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 18%,transparent)}
.page-results .t{font-weight:600;font-size:var(--t-sm);display:block}
.page-results .s{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-xs);display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:.15rem}
.page-results mark{background:var(--color-selection);color:var(--color-selection-text);border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px}
.page-results .none{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-xs);padding:.7rem}
.search-flash{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:var(--r-lg)}
.search-hit{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--yellow) 22%,transparent);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--yellow) 22%,transparent)}
.comp-btn span{margin-left:.35rem}
.comp-menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:1rem;background:var(--color-scrim);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.comp-menu.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.comp-panel{width:min(36rem,94vw);height:min(82vh,50rem);display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.99);transition:transform .42s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.comp-menu.open .comp-panel{transform:none}
.comp-panel header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:1rem 1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.comp-panel header h3{flex:1;margin:0;font-size:1.05rem}
.comp-search{position:relative;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.comp-search .ic{position:absolute;left:2rem;top:50%;translate:0 -50%;color:var(--dim);pointer-events:none}
.comp-search input{width:100%;padding-left:2.5rem}
.comp-list{overflow:auto;padding:.8rem 1.2rem 1.4rem}
.comp-group{margin-top:1.1rem}
.comp-group>b{display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;font:600 var(--t-xs) var(--fb);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:.6rem}
.comp-group>b span{color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:0}
.comp-items{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(10.5rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-2)}
.comp-items button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;text-align:left;font:500 var(--t-xs)/1.35 var(--fb);color:var(--mut);background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:.5rem .6rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s var(--ease),transform .28s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.comp-items button::before{content:"";width:.42rem;height:.42rem;border-radius:2px;background:var(--c,var(--blue));flex:none}
.comp-items button:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 50%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 13%,transparent);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.comp-empty{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm);padding:1.5rem .4rem;text-align:center}
.comp-result .t::before{content:"Component · ";color:var(--cyan);font-weight:600}
.comp-hit{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 16%,transparent)!important;transition:outline-color .3s var(--ease),background-color .3s var(--ease)}
@media(max-width:700px){.comp-btn span{display:none}.comp-btn{padding:0;width:2.75rem;min-height:2.75rem}}
.menu-search .ic{position:absolute;left:.8rem;top:50%;translate:0 -50%;color:var(--dim);pointer-events:none;font-size:1rem}
.menu-search input{padding-left:2.5rem;min-height:2.6rem;font-size:var(--t-sm);background:var(--surf)}
.menu-none{font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut);padding:.5rem .75rem;margin-bottom:.3rem}
nav.side a.hide-nav{display:none}
.nav-more{display:flex;width:100%;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:.7rem;padding:.55rem .75rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--surf);color:var(--mut);font:600 var(--t-xs)/1 var(--fb);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s var(--ease),color .25s var(--ease)}
.nav-more span{color:var(--cyan)}
.nav-more:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 45%,transparent)}
.nav-components{padding-top:.3rem}
.nav-components[hidden]{display:none}
.nav-group{margin-top:.7rem}
.nav-group>b{display:block;font:600 var(--t-xs)/1 var(--fb);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.reg-nav-item{display:flex;gap:.45rem;align-items:center;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:.35rem .5rem;border:0;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:0;color:var(--mut);font:500 var(--t-xs)/1.3 var(--fb);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .25s var(--ease),color .25s var(--ease)}
.reg-nav-item::before{content:"";width:.38rem;height:.38rem;border-radius:2px;background:var(--c,var(--blue));flex:none}
.reg-nav-item:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 14%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
.reg-nav-item.hide-nav{display:none}
.totop{position:fixed;right:1rem;bottom:calc(4.6rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:61;width:2.75rem;height:2.75rem;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg2) 88%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow);opacity:0;translate:0 10px;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease),translate .38s var(--ease-decelerate),background-color .25s var(--ease),transform .25s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.totop.on{opacity:1;translate:0 0;pointer-events:auto}
.totop:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 30%,var(--bg2));transform:translateY(-2px)}
.totop:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px}
.reg-tools{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;margin-bottom:1rem}
.reg-tools input{flex:1;min-width:14rem}
.reg{width:100%}

.rulebox{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.2rem 1.4rem;margin-top:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;width:100%}
.g2+.rulebox,.g2+.card,.rulebox+.card{margin-top:1.25rem}
.rulebox h3{margin:0 0 .5rem;font-size:1.05rem;display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center}
.rulebox p,.rulebox li{color:var(--mut);font-size:var(--t-sm);line-height:1.6}
.rulebox ol,.rulebox ul{padding-left:1.2rem;margin:.5rem 0}
.rulebox code{font:.8rem/1.5 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:var(--cyan);background:var(--surf);padding:.1rem .35rem;border-radius:5px}
.rulebox pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font:.78rem/1.6 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:1rem;color:var(--mut);overflow:auto}
.rulebox p,.rulebox li,.rulebox code{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word}
.rulebox .no{border-left:4px solid var(--red)}
.rulebox .yes{border-left:4px solid var(--green)}
.ok-txt{color:var(--green)}.bad-txt{color:var(--red)}

.deckframe{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);background:#050A1C;display:block}
.deckfull{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:#050A1C;display:block;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;padding:0;transition:opacity .38s var(--ease)}
.deckfull.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.deckfull .deckframe{height:100%;width:100%;aspect-ratio:auto;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
.deckclose{position:fixed;top:1rem;right:1rem;z-index:101;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease),transform .35s var(--ease-decelerate);transform:translateY(-6px)}
.deckfull.open~.deckclose{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease) .12s,transform .35s var(--ease-decelerate) .12s}
.tplgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(15rem,1fr));gap:var(--space-4);width:100%}
.tpl{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg2);cursor:pointer;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
.tpl:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cyan) 50%,transparent)}
.tpl .thumb{aspect-ratio:16/9;padding:.7rem;background:radial-gradient(100% 80% at 15% 0,#0B1840,transparent 65%),#050A1C;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;overflow:hidden}
.tpl .thumb span{font:600 .72rem/1.2 var(--fd);color:#EAF0FF}
.tpl .thumb i{display:block;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3B82F6,#22D3EE);opacity:.85}
.tpl .thumb .k{font:600 .5rem var(--fb);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#22D3EE}
.tpl .cap{padding:.55rem .7rem;font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--mut);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.4rem}
.tpl .cap b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

/* Motion polish: one decelerating curve for every interactive surface. */
#brand .demo.col{margin-top:var(--space-4)}
#brand .lock-clear{margin:var(--space-4) 0}
#brand .demo.col>.row{margin-top:var(--space-3)}
#brand .demo.col>p.muted{margin:var(--space-3) 0}
nav.side,.tv.hscroll,.kanban,.rbac,.org{overscroll-behavior:contain}
.btn{transition:transform .28s var(--ease-decelerate),box-shadow .28s var(--ease),filter .28s var(--ease),background-color .28s var(--ease),border-color .28s var(--ease)}
.card{transition:translate .38s var(--ease-decelerate),transform .38s var(--ease-decelerate),border-color .35s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s var(--ease)}
.in,select.in,textarea.in{transition:border-color .28s var(--ease),box-shadow .28s var(--ease),background-color .28s var(--ease)}
.tabs button,.pg button,.menu a,.chk,.chk input{transition:background-color .28s var(--ease),color .28s var(--ease),box-shadow .28s var(--ease),border-color .28s var(--ease),transform .28s var(--ease-decelerate)}
.sk{transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.sw-t{transition:background-color .38s var(--ease),border-color .38s var(--ease)}
.sw-t::after{transition:translate .42s var(--ease-decelerate),background-color .3s var(--ease)}
.tip::after{transition:opacity .28s var(--ease),translate .32s var(--ease-decelerate)}
details summary::after{transition:rotate .34s var(--ease-decelerate),color .25s var(--ease)}
.micogrid>div,.tpl{transition:transform .38s var(--ease-decelerate),translate .38s var(--ease-decelerate),border-color .32s var(--ease),background-color .32s var(--ease),box-shadow .32s var(--ease)}
.filegrid div,.kanban .task,.chip{transition:transform .34s var(--ease-decelerate),border-color .3s var(--ease),background-color .3s var(--ease)}
.bd,.al,.toast{transition:background-color .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease)}
.al.c-blue,.bd.c-blue{--c:var(--blue)}
.al.c-green,.bd.c-green{--c:var(--green)}
.al.c-red,.bd.c-red{--c:var(--red)}
.al.c-yel,.bd.c-yel{--c:var(--yellow)}
.al.c-cyan,.bd.c-cyan{--c:var(--cyan)}
.al.c-vio,.bd.c-vio{--c:var(--violet)}
.al.c-org,.bd.c-org{--c:var(--orange)}
a,.btn,.hb,nav.side a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
@media(max-width:700px){header.top .syschip,header.top .bd{display:none}header.top .global-search{width:auto;flex:1;min-width:0}header.top .global-search kbd{display:none}header.top .global-search input{min-width:0;width:100%}}
/* Ambient deck-style orb is decorative; keep it from creating a horizontal scrollbar. */
html,body{overflow-x:clip}
@media(max-width:480px){header.top .lock .d,header.top .lock .t{display:none}header.top{gap:.4rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.card:hover,.micogrid>div:hover,.tpl:hover{transform:none;translate:none}}

</style>
</head>

<main id="main"><div class="hero"><span class="eyebrow">Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</span>
<h1>Build <span class="grad">luminous</span> interfaces, faster.</h1>
<p>The Inovix design system: glass surfaces, ambient glow, semantic color for every action, and hundreds of accessible components. Dark by default, light on demand.</p>
<div class="demo" style="background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0"><a class="btn lg b-primary" href="#buttons">Explore components <svg class="ic"><use href="#i-chev"/></svg></a><a class="btn lg o b-primary" href="#tokens">View tokens</a></div></div>
<section id="quickstart"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Quick start for agents</h2><p>One decision, one copy, one output file. Follow this before reading the rest of the system.</p></div><span class="tag">Start here</span></div>
<div class="rulebox yes"><h3>Dispatch rule</h3><pre>build / create / implement + app      -> App starter template
make / build / create + presentation  -> Presentation starter template

Output ONE new standalone .html file.
Never link to, embed or summarise this design system.
Never invent colours, fonts, spacing, icons or logo marks.</pre></div>
<div class="g2">
 <div class="card c-blue"><div class="k">Presentation</div><h3>Copy full presentation starter</h3><p>Complete canonical deck: stage, engine, HUD, lockup, deco, motion, navigation, reduced-motion.</p></div>
 <div class="card c-cyan"><div class="k">App</div><h3>Copy full app starter</h3><p>Complete working shell: navy header, three-line lockup, sidebar, bento, forms, table, modal, toast, themes.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="rulebox"><h3>Final validation</h3><pre>[ ] one self-contained .html file
[ ] exact three-line INOVIX lockup, DejaVu Sans 400
[ ] token-only values; no hardcoded visual values
[ ] responsive + keyboard + reduced motion
[ ] no console errors
[ ] presentation: 16:9 stage, HUD, deck engine, 5-17 slides</pre></div>
</section>
<section id="contract"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>The contract</h2><p>One URL. One source of truth. This file is the complete specification.</p></div><span class="tag">Agent entry point</span></div>
<p class="lead">Copy the URL of this page from your browser's address bar and paste it after the sentence below. Give that one line to an AI agent. The agent must read the whole document at that URL and infer every component, state, token, motion rule, app shell and slide layout the request implies. Nothing else needs to be named or attached.</p>
<div class="demo col"><span class="lbl">1 · Copy this page's URL from the address bar &nbsp; 2 · Paste it after "Follow this design system:" &nbsp; 3 · Send the line to your agent</span>
<div class="promptbar"><code id="follow-prompt">Follow this design system: </code><button class="btn sm b-primary copy-btn" id="copy-prompt" data-tip="Copy prompt with this page's URL">Copy full line</button></div>
<p class="muted">When this file is hosted, the hosted URL is shown below; when it is opened locally, only the relative filename is shown, never a machine-specific absolute path. <strong>Copy full line</strong> copies exactly what is displayed. To share from a hosted copy, copy that page's URL from your browser address bar and paste it after the phrase.</p>
</div>
<div class="g2" style="margin-top:1rem">
<div class="card c-blue"><span class="mini">For an app</span><h3>"Build an App using the Inovix design system."</h3><p>Produce a working app: navy Holy Grail shell, text-only three-line INOVIX lockup, collapsible sidebar, fluid main, token-only styling, light and dark themes, Lucide icons, all states and skeletons.</p><a class="btn s b-primary" href="#apprules">Read app rules</a></div>
<div class="card c-violet"><span class="mini">For a deck</span><h3>"Make a presentation on XYZ using the Inovix design system."</h3><p>Produce a single self-contained HTML file with the 16:9 stage, <code>--u</code> unit, glass cards, orbs, deco layers, staggered entrances, HUD, keyboard navigation and the slide templates below.</p><a class="btn s b-violet" href="#presentation">Read deck rules</a></div>
</div>
<div class="rulebox yes"><h3><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg> Authority order</h3><ol><li>This HTML file is the SSOT for every Inovix app and presentation. There is one design system, defined here.</li><li>Both token roles are preserved: app tokens (<code>--color-*</code>, navy <code>#03182D</code>) govern apps; presentation tokens (<code>--bg #050A1C</code>, five accents, <code>--u</code>) govern decks.</li><li>The logo rule is absolute and shared: text only, three lines, two colors, no image or icon. Never substitute a gradient mark or emoji.</li></ol></div>
</section>


<section id="brand"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Brand identity</h2><p>Exact INOVIX lockup and construction spec, set in DejaVu Sans with two approved colors.</p></div><span class="tag">Zero drift</span></div>
<div class="logo-spec">
  <div class="on-navy"><a class="brand-link" href="#brand" aria-label="INOVIX SOFTWARE LABS home"><span class="lock navy lock-demo"><span class="w">INOVIX</span><span class="d">SOFTWARE LABS</span><span class="t">Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</span></span></a></div>
  <div class="on-white"><a class="brand-link" href="#brand" aria-label="INOVIX SOFTWARE LABS home"><span class="lock light lock-demo"><span class="w">INOVIX</span><span class="d">SOFTWARE LABS</span><span class="t">Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</span></span></a></div>
  <div class="on-deck"><a class="brand-link" href="#brand" aria-label="INOVIX SOFTWARE LABS home"><span class="lock navy lock-demo"><span class="w">INOVIX</span><span class="d">SOFTWARE LABS</span><span class="t">Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</span></span></a></div>
</div>
<div class="demo col"><span class="lbl">Construction (verbatim spec)</span>
<div class="tv"><table><tbody>
<tr><td><code>INOVIX</code></td><td>Wordmark, 100 u nominal, DejaVu Sans 400, tracking tight</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>SOFTWARE LABS</code></td><td>Descriptor, 15 u, baseline -34 u, custom spaced to wordmark width</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</code></td><td>Tagline, 12 u, baseline -63 u, centered by visible ink bounds</td></tr>
<tr><td>Geometry</td><td>Outline 1.1 u, glyph advance 13 u, layout width 336.56 u</td></tr>
<tr><td>Colors</td><td>Exactly two: white <code>#FFFFFF</code> and navy <code>#03182D</code> (legacy alpha 252/255, solid preferred)</td></tr>
<tr><td>Combo</td><td>On navy / dark / deck: all three lines white. On light / white: all three lines navy.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
<div class="row"><span class="bd c-red">Forbidden: recolor</span><span class="bd c-red">stretch</span><span class="bd c-red">shadow</span><span class="bd c-red">background box</span><span class="bd c-red">icon or mark</span><span class="bd c-red">emoji</span><span class="bd c-red">animation</span><span class="bd c-red">cropping</span><span class="bd c-red">re-layout of the 3 lines</span><span class="bd c-red">two-tone letter split</span></div>
<p class="muted">An earlier draft used a gradient square and an emoji favicon. Both are rejected: the text-only lockup is canonical. Clear space, minimum size, dark-background and print rules remain tokenised and flagged <em>pending brand approval</em>.</p>
<div class="lock-clear"><span class="lock navy"><span class="w">INOVIX</span><span class="d">SOFTWARE LABS</span><span class="t">Engineering Intelligence. Securing the Future.</span></span></div>
<p class="muted">One wordmark x-height of clear space on all four sides. Nothing enters it. Touch target for the logo link is at least 2.75rem square with a focus-visible ring and <code>aria-label="INOVIX SOFTWARE LABS home"</code>.</p>
</div></section>


<section id="colors"><h2>Color</h2><p>Brand palette from the decks plus a full semantic set for actions and states.</p>
<div class="demo"><span class="lbl">Brand</span><div class="sw">
<div style="background:#3B82F6">Blue<span>#3B82F6 · primary</span></div><div style="background:#22D3EE;color:#04222B;text-shadow:none">Cyan<span>#22D3EE · info</span></div><div style="background:#2DD4BF;color:#04222B;text-shadow:none">Teal<span>#2DD4BF</span></div><div style="background:#9B7BFF">Violet<span>#9B7BFF</span></div><div style="background:#FBBF24;color:#2A1E00;text-shadow:none">Amber<span>#FBBF24</span></div></div>
<span class="lbl">Semantic</span><div class="sw">
<div style="background:#22C55E">Success<span>#22C55E · green</span></div><div style="background:#EF4444">Danger<span>#EF4444 · red</span></div><div style="background:#FACC15;color:#2A1E00;text-shadow:none">Warning<span>#FACC15 · yellow</span></div><div style="background:#F97316">Alert<span>#F97316 · orange</span></div><div style="background:#64748B">Secondary<span>#64748B · slate</span></div></div></div></section>
<section id="type"><h2>Typography</h2><p>Sora for display, Inter for UI. Fluid sizes via clamp().</p>
<div class="demo col"><h1>Display heading</h1><h2>Section heading</h2><h3>Card heading</h3><div>Body text, 0.95rem. <a href="#type">Inline link</a> · <b>Bold</b> · <code style="background:var(--surf);padding:.1rem .4rem;border-radius:6px">code</code></div><small style="color:var(--mut)">Caption / helper text</small></div></section>

Always paired with text or ARIA status.</p><div class="stack"><div class="row"><span class="spin" style="width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem"></span><span class="bd c-cyan">Loading…</span><div class="sk" style="width:5rem"></div><div class="sk" style="width:3rem;height:3rem;border-radius:50%"></div></div><div class="bar" style="--v:68%"><i></i></div><svg class="ch" viewBox="0 0 120 40" style="max-width:8rem"><path d="M10 34A50 50 0 0 1 110 34" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M10 34A50 50 0 0 1 110 34" fill="none" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="68 100"/></svg><button class="btn sm b-primary" id="gallery-load"><span class="spin" hidden></span>Load</button></div></div>
<div class="card c-violet span2"><span class="mini">Typography</span><h3>Type specimen</h3><p class="muted">Inter for UI, Sora for display, DejaVu Sans only in the logo. Every size is fluid via clamp() and paired with a token line-height.</p><div class="type-spec"><div style="font:600 clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.4rem) var(--fd)">Display · Sora 600</div><div style="font:600 1.4rem var(--fd)">Heading · Sora 600</div><div style="font:500 1.05rem var(--fb)">Body · Inter 500 · 1.5 line height</div><div style="font:400 .85rem var(--fb)">Caption · Inter 400 · tertiary text</div><div style="font:400 .85rem var(--font-mono)">0123456789 · DejaVu Sans Mono</div><div><b>Weights</b> 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 · <b>Tracking</b> -0.02em display, 0.025em wide labels</div></div></div>
<div class="card c-blue span2"><span class="mini">Color &amp; elevation</span><h3>Palette, surfaces and depth</h3><p class="muted">Brand navy anchors apps; deck navy anchors presentations. Neutrals are navy-tinted, never pure grey. Elevation is token-composed.</p><div class="sw-line"><i style="background:#03182D">navy</i><i style="background:#3B82F6">blue</i><i style="background:#22D3EE;color:#04222B">cyan</i><i style="background:#2DD4BF;color:#04222B">teal</i><i style="background:#9B7BFF">violet</i><i style="background:#FBBF24;color:#2A1E00">amber</i><i style="background:#22C55E">success</i><i style="background:#EF4444">danger</i></div><div class="elev-row"><div style="box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs)">Level 1</div><div style="box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)">Level 2</div><div style="box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)">Level 3</div><div style="box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)">Level 4</div><div style="box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl)">Level 5</div></div></div>
<div class="card c-red"><span class="mini">Validation</span><h3>Forms with field states</h3><p class="muted">Label above, Required marker, helper below, 3rem field, glowing focus ring, success and error variants.</p><div class="stack"><div class="f"><label for="g-ok">Email <em>*</em></label><input id="g-ok" class="in ok" value="ada@inovix.com"><span class="hint ok">Looks good</span></div><div class="f"><label for="g-bad">Password <em>*</em></label><input id="g-bad" class="in bad" type="password" value="123"><span class="hint bad">Use at least 8 characters</span></div><div class="f"><label>Readonly</label><input class="in" value="Locked value" readonly></div></div></div>
<div class="card c-orange"><span class="mini">Empty &amp; error states</span><h3>Recovery patterns</h3><p class="muted">Every empty, offline, error and zero-result state offers a next action and an icon plus text, never color alone.</p><div class="empty" style="padding:1rem"><div class="ico" style="--c:var(--amber)"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-cloud"/></svg></div><h3>No projects yet</h3><p>Create your first project.</p><button class="btn sm b-primary"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg>New project</button></div></div>
<div class="card c-cyan"><span class="mini">Navigation</span><h3>Breadcrumbs, tabs, pagination</h3><p class="muted">Current page marked with accent-soft fill and a 3-unit edge.
