<section id="a11y"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Accessibility &amp; internationalization</h2><p>Keyboard, focus, ARIA, contrast, RTL, locale formats, text expansion and reduced motion are part of every component.</p></div><span class="tag">Inclusive by default</span></div>
<div class="bento">
<div class="card c-blue"><span class="mini">Keyboard</span><h3>Tab order &amp; focus</h3><p class="muted">Tab moves in DOM order; Shift+Tab reverses. Every target shows a 2px cyan ring with 3px offset. No positive tabindex values.</p><div class="tabseq"><span tabindex="0">1 · Focus me</span><span tabindex="0">2 · Then me</span><span tabindex="0">3 · Then me</span><span tabindex="0">4 · Then me</span></div><div class="tv" style="margin-top:.8rem"><table><tbody><tr><td><code>Tab / Shift+Tab</code></td><td>Next / previous control</td></tr><tr><td><code>Enter / Space</code></td><td>Activate button</td></tr><tr><td><code>Esc</code></td><td>Close overlay</td></tr><tr><td><code>/</code></td><td>Focus page search</td></tr><tr><td><code>⌘/Ctrl+K</code></td><td>Focus page search</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
<div class="card c-green"><span class="mini">Screen readers</span><h3>ARIA &amp; live regions</h3><p class="muted">Icon-only buttons carry aria-label, status changes use polite live regions, decorative SVG is hidden, and dialogs trap focus.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn sm b-primary" id="aria-demo">Announce update</button><span class="bd c-green dot" id="aria-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Ready</span></div><p class="muted" style="margin-top:.7rem">Via the header: <a href="#main" class="skip-link">Skip to content</a></p></div>
<div class="card c-violet"><span class="mini">Contrast &amp; touch</span><h3>AA minimum, 44px targets</h3><p class="muted">Body text targets AAA 7:1 where feasible and never drops below 4.5:1; UI and focus indicators meet 3:1. Disabled text is exempt but stays legible.</p><div class="row"><span class="bd c-green">Primary 17.13:1</span><span class="bd c-green">Secondary 8.75:1</span><span class="bd c-green">Accent 5.84:1</span><span class="bd c-green">Focus 5.84:1</span></div><p class="muted" style="margin-top:.7rem">Touch targets: 2.75rem minimum, 3rem preferred. Pointer: fine hover effects, coarse drops hover-only paths.</p></div>
<div class="card c-cyan"><span class="mini">RTL</span><h3>Bidirectional mirror</h3><p class="muted">Margins, padding, icons and stepper direction flip under <code>dir="rtl"</code>; numbers and product names stay LTR via bidi isolation.</p><div class="rtlbox" dir="rtl">هذه واجهة INOVIX مع دعم كامل للغة العربية · ١٢٣٤</div></div>
<div class="card c-amber"><span class="mini">Localization</span><h3>Language &amp; locale formats</h3><p class="muted">Locale codes only, never flags. Dates, numbers, currency and first day of week come from the locale; untranslated strings fall back safely.</p><div class="row"><select class="in" id="locale-select" aria-label="Locale" style="max-width:12rem"><option value="en-US">en-US</option><option value="ar-SA">ar-SA</option><option value="hi-IN">hi-IN</option><option value="de-DE">de-DE</option></select></div><div class="locale-grid" style="margin-top:.7rem"><div><b>Date</b><span id="fmt-date"></span></div><div><b>Number</b><span id="fmt-num"></span></div><div><b>Currency</b><span id="fmt-cur"></span></div><div><b>Timezone</b><span id="fmt-tz"></span></div></div></div>
<div class="card c-teal"><span class="mini">Text expansion</span><h3>Long strings &amp; truncation</h3><p class="muted">Labels wrap, never clip. CJK, Cyrillic, Devanagari and Arabic line-height overrides are tokenized; ellipsis applies only to single-line metadata.</p><p class="muted">Deutsch: Benutzerberechtigungen und Zugriffssteuerung für mehrere Organizationen</p><p class="muted">日本語: ユーザー権限とアクセス制御の設定</p></div>
<div class="card c-red"><span class="mini">Reduced motion</span><h3>Motion off, meaning intact</h3><p class="muted">With <code>prefers-reduced-motion: reduce</code>, every duration becomes 0, shimmer stops, parallax and particle draw disable, and non-essential sound is silenced.</p><span class="bd c-green dot">Respected globally</span></div>
<div class="card c-blue"><span class="mini">Forced colors</span><h3>High contrast fallback</h3><p class="muted">Glass, alpha and saturate are replaced by solid surface tokens; borders and focus rings rely on system colors so structure survives forced-colors mode.</p><span class="bd c-cyan">Solid fallback token</span></div>
</div></section>
<section id="states"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Full state matrix</h2><p>The 26 states every interactive component must define, with cursor, background, border, text, icon, animation, sound and ARIA.</p></div><span class="tag">Mandatory</span></div>
<div class="demo col"><div class="state-grid">
<div><b>default</b>Resting, token palette, cursor default.</div><div><b>hover</b>Lift, tinted border, pointer.</div><div><b>hovered-click</b>Hover plus pressed tint.</div><div><b>pressed / active</b>Scale .98, deeper fill.</div>
<div><b>clicked</b>Committed state, current marker.</div><div><b>focus-visible</b>2px cyan ring, 3px offset.</div><div><b>focus</b>Programmatic focus, no ring.</div><div><b>disabled</b>Opacity .38, not-allowed.</div>
<div><b>disabled + hover</b>No lift, no pointer.</div><div><b>disabled + pressed</b>No state change.</div><div><b>selected / checked</b>Accent fill, check icon.</div><div><b>unselected</b>Outline, empty control.</div>
<div><b>expanded / collapsed</b>Chevron rotate, panel height.</div><div><b>open / closed</b>Menu or popover visibility.</div><div><b>active menu item</b>Accent-soft fill + edge.</div><div><b>current page</b>3-unit accent edge.</div>
<div><b>visited link</b>Distinct token, still readable.</div><div><b>invalid + disabled</b>Error border, muted.</div><div><b>readonly</b>Filled but immutable.</div><div><b>required + filled</b>Required marker satisfied.</div>
<div><b>loading + disabled</b>Spinner, progress cursor.</div><div><b>skeleton + hover</b>Shimmer, no interaction.</div><div><b>offline</b>Offline token, retry action.</div><div><b>empty</b>Illustration + next action.</div>
<div><b>error</b>Error token + icon + text.</div><div><b>success</b>Success token + icon + text.</div>
</div></div>
<div class="rulebox"><h3>Sound and haptics</h3><p>All sound events are OFF by default and referenced by token only: <code>--sound-success</code>, <code>--sound-error</code>, <code>--sound-warning</code>, <code>--sound-notification</code>, <code>--sound-toggle</code>, <code>--sound-click</code>, <code>--sound-upload-complete</code>, <code>--sound-message</code>. Haptic pairs: light 10ms, medium 25ms, heavy 50ms, selection 8ms. Reduced motion silences non-essential sound. No autoplay.</p></div>
</section>


<section id="micro"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Micro-interactions</h2><p>Small, deliberate motion. Transform and opacity only, GPU-friendly, disabled under reduced motion.</p></div><span class="tag">Craft</span></div>
<div class="micogrid">
<div><b>Hover lift</b><small>Cards translate -4px and reveal a cursor-following radial spotlight via <code>--mx</code>/<code>--my</code>.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm b-primary" data-tip="Hover me">Hover me</button><span class="dotp"></span></div></div>
<div><b>Focus ring</b><small>2px cyan outline, 3px offset. Every target stays keyboard reachable.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm o b-primary">Tab to focus</button></div></div>
<div><b>Pressed &amp; active</b><small>Scale .98 on press, active nav uses accent-soft fill and a 3-unit edge.</small><div class="demoline"><span class="bd solid">Active</span><span class="bd">Idle</span></div></div>
<div><b>Loading</b><small>Spinner on a disabled button, progress cursor, skeleton shimmer at 1400ms.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm b-primary" id="ld2"><span class="spin" hidden></span>Load</button><div class="sk" style="width:4rem"></div></div></div>
<div><b>Tooltip</b><small>Delay 300ms, arrow, never the only source of meaning.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm s b-info tip" data-tip="Helper text">Tooltip</button></div></div>
<div><b>Toast stacking</b><small>Bottom-right, 4s dwell, newest on top, polite live region.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm b-success" data-toast="success">Toast</button><button class="btn sm b-danger" data-toast="error">Error</button></div></div>
<div><b>Modal &amp; drawer</b><small>Backdrop blur 8px, focus trap, Escape and scrim close, focus returns.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm b-primary" data-open="m1">Modal</button><button class="btn sm o b-primary" data-open="m3">Drawer</button></div></div>
<div><b>Tabs &amp; stepper</b><small>Selected tab slides into an accent pill; steps check off in sequence.</small><div class="demoline"><div class="tabs"><button aria-selected="true">One</button><button aria-selected="false">Two</button></div></div></div>
<div><b>Drag &amp; reorder</b><small>Grab / grabbing cursor, ghost at 40% opacity, drop indicator line.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm gh ib" aria-label="Drag handle"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-grip"/></svg></button><span class="bd c-vio">Drag handle</span></div></div>
<div><b>Dots &amp; presence</b><small>Unread markers, notification dots, online presence rings, all paired with text.</small><div class="demoline"><span class="av on">AK</span><span class="bd dot c-green">Online</span><span class="bd solid c-red">3</span></div></div>
<div><b>Selection &amp; copy</b><small>Selection token colors highlight; copy button confirms with a success toast.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm gh" id="copy-demo"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-copy"/></svg> Copy text</button></div></div>
<div><b>Undo / redo</b><small>Stacked actions with 5s salvage window and keyboard shortcuts.</small><div class="demoline"><button class="btn sm gh ib" aria-label="Undo"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-undo"/></svg></button><button class="btn sm gh ib" aria-label="Redo"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-redo"/></svg></button></div></div>
<div><b>Scroll &amp; snap</b><small>Anchor offset for sticky header, optional scroll-snap on rails, custom navy scrollbar.</small><div class="demoline"><span class="bd c-cyan">Sticky header</span><span class="bd c-teal">Snap rail</span></div></div>
<div><b>Reduced motion</b><small>All durations become 0, springs set instantly, shimmer stops, autoplay off, sweep disabled.</small><div class="demoline"><span class="bd c-green dot">Respected</span></div></div>
</div>
</section>



<section id="presentation"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Presentation system</h2><p>The live corporate deck below is the canonical reference for every HTML presentation. It is embedded verbatim from the canonical corporate deck — same CSS, same slide engine, same 17 slides.</p></div><span class="tag">Dual mode</span></div>
<div class="rulebox yes"><h3>Mandatory presentation checklist — read before generating</h3><ol>
<li><strong>One standalone HTML file.</strong> Copy the Presentation starter below; change only the slide content. Never link, embed, or summarise this design system.</li>
<li><strong>Full-bleed 16:9 stage</strong> with one active slide at a time. No scrolling article layout.</li>
<li><strong>Every dimension derives from <code>--u:min(1vw,1.7778vh)</code>.</strong> No invented rem/clamp spacing.</li>
<li><strong>Deck engine:</strong> active/before/after states, progress segments, counter, hash deep links <code>#sN</code>, inactive slides <code>aria-hidden</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Navigation:</strong> ← → ↑ ↓, Space/Enter/PageDown, Backspace/PageUp, Home/End, <code>F</code> fullscreen, <code>M</code> menu, <code>sN</code> direct slide, wheel and touch swipe.</li>
<li><strong>HUD:</strong> exact three-line, text-only lockup — INOVIX / SOFTWARE LABS / ENGINEERING INTELLIGENCE, SECURING THE FUTURE — in DejaVu Sans 400. No icon, image, emoji or gradient mark.</li>
<li><strong>Decoration:</strong> seeded ring, dots, cross, blob and diamond with parallax, plus three drifting blurred orbs and a masked grid.</li>
<li><strong>Cards:</strong> glass surfaces, cursor-following radial spotlight, hover scale and accent border.</li>
<li><strong>Entrances:</strong> staggered variants rise, left, right, zoom, fade, grow and grow-y.</li>
<li><strong>Reduced motion</strong> disables all animation/transition; focus-visible rings remain.</li>
</ol><p><strong>Slide count:</strong> the canonical deck has 17 slides. For a new topic, use 5–17 sparse slides chosen by content — never pad to 17, never exceed 17. One idea per slide, 3–5 cards max.</p><p><strong>Visual regression reference:</strong> the live deck below is the pixel reference. Slide 1 has the eyebrow, large Sora title, one supporting line and a three-card bento on a dark navy stage with orbs and geometry; the HUD lockup sits top-left, progress and counter bottom-centre. Match that before shipping.</p></div>
<div class="demo col"><span class="lbl">Live reference deck · 17 slides · keyboard, wheel, touch and hash navigation</span>
<iframe class="deckframe" id="deckframe" title="Inovix corporate deck — canonical presentation template" loading="eager"></iframe>
<div class="row"><button class="btn b-primary" id="deck-open"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-chev"/></svg> Open fullscreen</button><span class="hint">Click the stage, then use ← →, PageUp/Down, Space, Home, End, M for menu, F for fullscreen. Segments and the slide menu are interactive.</span></div>
</div>
<div class="g2" style="margin-top:1rem"><div class="rulebox yes"><h3>Presentation rules</h3><ul>
<li>One self-contained HTML file. Inline CSS and vanilla JS, no build step, no framework. Only external resource is the pinned Google Fonts stylesheet for Inter and Sora.</li>
<li>Full-bleed 16:9 stage. Every dimension derives from <code>--u:min(1vw,1.7778vh)</code>, so 1u is 1% of stage width and 1.7778vh of height. Type uses <code>max(base-px, calc(var(--u)*factor))</code> with a hard minimum.</li>
<li>Exact palette: <code>--bg #050A1C</code>, <code>--ink #EAF0FF</code>, <code>--mut #9DABD0</code>, <code>--dim #7080A8</code>, <code>--line rgba(160,185,255,.15)</code>; accents blue <code>#3B82F6</code>, cyan <code>#22D3EE</code>, teal <code>#2DD4BF</code>, violet <code>#9B7BFF</code>, amber <code>#FBBF24</code>.</li>
<li>Background: radial navy gradients, masked grid, three drifting blurred orbs, deterministic seeded deco per slide (ring, dots, cross, blob, diamond) with parallax at <code>data-depth</code>.</li>
<li>Cards: glass gradient surface, 14px backdrop blur, hairline border, cursor-following radial spotlight, hover scale 1.015 and accent border.</li>
<li>Deck engine <code>window.__deck</code> toggles <code>.active/.before/.after</code>, updates <code>aria-hidden</code>, progress segments, menu and counter, moves orbs, runs counters and supports <code>#sN</code> deep links.</li>
<li>Entrance stagger: every <code>.a</code> element gets <code>--i</code>; delay is <code>.2s + i*.075s</code>. Variants: rise, fromleft, fromright, zoom, fade, grow, growy.</li>
<li>Text-only INOVIX lockup in the HUD. No logo image, no emoji. Brand navy and white only.</li>
<li>Breakpoint 900px: <code>--u:9px</code>, grids collapse to 1fr, slides scroll vertically, decorative elements reduce. Reduced motion zeroes animations, particle draw and parallax.</li>
<li>Accessibility: inactive slides <code>aria-hidden="true"</code>, labelled buttons, decorative SVG marked hidden, focus-visible cyan ring, meaningful icons paired with text.</li>
</ul></div>
<div class="rulebox"><h3>Keyboard contract</h3><div class="tv"><table><thead><tr><th>Input</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><code>← / ↑ / Backspace</code></td><td>Previous slide</td></tr><tr><td><code>→ / ↓ / PageDown / Space / Enter</code></td><td>Next slide</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>Home / End</code></td><td>First / last slide</td></tr><tr><td><code>F</code></td><td>Fullscreen</td></tr><tr><td><code>M / Esc</code></td><td>Open / close slide menu</td></tr><tr><td>Wheel / touch swipe</td><td>Next / previous slide</td></tr><tr><td><code>#sN</code></td><td>Deep link to slide N</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div><p class="muted">Counters animate with <code>Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)))</code> over 1.5s. The marquee track is duplicated at init for a seamless 46s loop.</p></div></div>
<div class="sechead" style="margin-top:2rem"><div><h3 style="font-size:1.2rem">Slide templates</h3><p>Every canonical slide shape. Select one to open that slide in the reference deck.</p></div><span class="tag">17 patterns</span></div>
<div class="tplgrid" id="tplgrid"></div>
</section>

<section id="apprules"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Building an app</h2><p>Rules an agent follows when asked to build an App using the Inovix design system.</p></div><span class="tag">Apps</span></div>
<div class="rulebox yes"><h3><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg> Mandatory app recipe</h3><ol>
<li>Output the real app in the requested framework. Load Inter 400/500/600/700 and DejaVu Sans 400 from the pinned sources in the token reference; never use DejaVu Sans for UI text.</li>
<li>Use the Holy Grail shell: fixed navy <code>#03182D</code> header, top-left three-line text-only INOVIX lockup, animated hamburger-to-X, collapsible fixed sidebar, fluid main region as the only scroll container, always-visible footer with the dynamic current year.</li>
<li>Copy the full <code>:root</code> token block from this document into the app's one token file. Every visual value references a token. No hardcoded colors, spacing, radii, shadows, z-index or durations in components.</li>
<li>Page heading rhythm: breadcrumbs → <code>--space-3</code> → title → <code>--space-1</code> → one supporting line → <code>--space-6</code> → content card. Never let flex or grid stretch those gaps.</li>
<li>Content card: raised surface, hairline border, large radius, header row, body fields, footer row with buttons inside the card. Labels above fields, Required marker, helper/error below, 3rem inputs, token focus ring.</li>
<li>Primary action: navy in light theme with white text; bright navy-family <code>#79B6F4</code> in dark theme with navy text. Secondary action is ghost. Icon-only buttons need aria-label and tooltip.</li>
<li>Every data-driven component ships a skeleton with the matching shape, 1400ms shimmer, and empty, loading, error and offline states.</li>
<li>Define all 26 states from this page for every interactive component, including cursor, sound (silent by default), responsive behavior, RTL mirror, print and ARIA.</li>
<li>Light and dark themes both work; first visit follows the OS; theme is one root attribute swap. Header stays navy with white lockup in both.</li>
<li>Keyboard, focus-visible, WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum body contrast, 3:1 UI/focus, 44px touch targets, forced-colors and reduced motion are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.</li>
</ol></div>
<div class="g2">
<div class="rulebox no"><h3>Never</h3><ul><li>Gradient square, SVG, PNG, emoji or icon as the logo.</li><li>Fixed 64px header or 240px sidebar instead of clamp tokens.</li><li><code>main</code> as a flex column with <code>--space-section</code> gaps between breadcrumbs, title, subtitle and card.</li><li>Pure gray or pure black neutrals, neon semantic colors, or a second interactive accent hue.</li><li>Converting a shadow token to another format; copy verbatim.</li><li>Right sidebar; the shell is Holy Grail with no right rail.</li></ul></div>
<div class="rulebox yes"><h3>Always</h3><ul><li>Semantic token names only: <code>--color-text-secondary</code>, never "gray-500".</li><li>Lucide icons by name, sized by <code>--icon-size-*</code>, stroke <code>1.5</code> default.</li><li>Collapse → stack → hide in that order; <code>display:none</code> is never the only responsive response.</li><li>Text with icon for status; color alone never carries meaning.</li><li>Information modal: tinted icon circle, title, label/value rows, one primary button, blurred scrim, focus trap, Escape and scrim close, focus returns.</li><li>One token-file swap for white-label rebrands; no component edits.</li></ul></div>
</div>
<div class="rulebox"><h3>Minimal token scaffold</h3><pre>:root {
  --color-navy-950:#03182D; --color-navy-975:#010D1C;
  --color-surface-base:#F8FAFD; --color-surface-raised:#FFFFFF;
  --color-text-primary:#03182D; --color-accent:#0961BB;
  --color-header-bg:#03182D; --color-header-text:#FCFCFC;
  --space-4:1rem; --radius-lg:1rem; --shadow-md:0 4px 6px rgb(3 24 45 / 0.07), 0 2px 4px rgb(3 24 45 / 0.05);
  --duration-fast:150ms; --ease-standard:cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --touch-target-min:2.75rem; --z-header:30;
}
[data-theme=dark]{
  --color-surface-base:#010D1C; --color-surface-raised:#0A1F34;
  --color-text-primary:#E8EDF3; --color-accent:#79B6F4;
  --shadow-md:0 4px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25);
}
/* Copy the complete token tables from the Foundations section above. */</pre></div>
</section>


<section id="qa"><div class="sechead"><div><h2>Quality bar</h2><p>Check this before shipping an app or a deck.</p></div><span class="tag">Definition of done</span></div>
<div class="bento">
<div class="card c-blue"><h3>Visual</h3><p class="muted">Brand lockup exact, palette exact, spacing on the 8px scale, elevation on the token scale, glass has a solid fallback, no drift from this file.</p></div>
<div class="card c-green"><h3>Interaction</h3><p class="muted">All 26 states, hover lift, focus ring, loading, skeleton, toast, modal, drawer, tooltip and reduced-motion path verified.</p></div>
<div class="card c-violet"><h3>Accessibility</h3><p class="muted">Keyboard only pass, focus order, ARIA names, live regions, AA contrast, 44px targets, forced colors, RTL mirror.</p></div>
<div class="card c-cyan"><h3>Responsive</h3><p class="muted">320, 640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536px checks. Collapse, stack, hide in order. No horizontal overflow.</p></div>
<div class="card c-amber"><h3>Self-contained</h3><p class="muted">One HTML file, embedded CSS and JS, inline SVG sprites, inlined images. Only external resource is the pinned font stylesheet.</p></div>
<div class="card c-teal"><h3>Implementation library</h3><p class="muted">Every named component, context, chart, graph, map, micro pattern and i18n rule used by the request is present in the implementation library below.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="rulebox"><h3>Regression rule</h3><p>Fixes must not change an already-correct token, state, layout or interaction. Verify visually after each change and keep every previously working pattern intact.</p></div>
</section>

<section id="tokens"><h2>Tokens</h2><p>Copy into your app's :root. Light values live under [data-theme=light].</p>
<pre class="code">:root {
  --blue:#3B82F6; --cyan:#22D3EE; --teal:#2DD4BF; --violet:#9B7BFF; --amber:#FBBF24;
  --green:#22C55E; --red:#EF4444; --yellow:#FACC15; --orange:#F97316;
  --bg:#050A1C; --bg2:#0A1330; --ink:#EAF0FF; --mut:#9DABD0; --line:rgba(160,185,255,.16);
  --fd:'Sora',system-ui,sans-serif; --fb:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --r-sm:8px; --r-md:12px; --r-lg:20px; --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.15,1);
}</pre></section>

All data will be permanently removed.</p><footer><button class="btn gh" data-close>Cancel</button><button class="btn b-danger" data-close data-toast="error">Delete</button></footer></div></div>
<div class="scrim drawer" id="m3" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="m3t"><div class="modal"><header><h3 id="m3t">Settings</h3><button class="btn gh ib sm" data-close aria-label="Close"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-x"/></svg></button></header><div class="f"><label>Display name</label><input class="in" value="Inovix"></div><br><label class="chk"><input class="ios" type="checkbox" checked role="switch">Email notifications</label><footer><button class="btn b-primary" data-close>Save</button></footer></div></div>
<div class="comp-menu" id="comp-menu" aria-hidden="true">
 <div class="comp-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Component menu">
  <header><h3>Component menu</h3><span class="bd c-cyan" id="comp-count">484</span><button class="btn gh ib sm" id="comp-close" aria-label="Close component menu"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-x"/></svg></button></header>
  <div class="comp-search"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-search"/></svg><input id="comp-search" class="in" type="search" placeholder="Search all components" aria-label="Search all components" autocomplete="off"></div>
  <div class="comp-list" id="comp-list"></div>
 </div>

<script>
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s),$$=(s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
$('#yr').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
const ic=n=>`<svg class="ic"><use href="#i-${n}"/></svg>`;
function setIcon(){$('#tt').innerHTML=ic(document.documentElement.dataset.theme==='dark'?'sun':'moon')}setIcon();
$('#tt').onclick=()=>{const t=document.documentElement.dataset.theme==='dark'?'light':'dark';document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;try{localStorage.setItem('ix-theme',t)}catch(e){}setIcon()};
// tabs
$$('.tabs button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{$$('.tabs button').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x===b));$('#tp').textContent=b.textContent+': content for this tab.'});
// dropdown
$('#ddb').onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();$('#ddm').classList.toggle('open')};document.addEventListener('click',()=>$('#ddm').classList.remove('open'));
// modals
let last;const open=id=>{last=document.activeElement;const m=$('#'+id);m.classList.add('open');($('button,input',m)||m).focus()};const close=()=>{$$('.scrim.open').forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('open'));last&&last.focus()};
$$('[data-open]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>open(b.dataset.open));$$('[data-close]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',close));
$$('.scrim').forEach(s=>s.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===s)close()}));document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')close()});
// toasts
const T={success:['ok','Saved','Changes were saved.','--green'],error:['err','Error','Something went wrong.','--red'],warn:['warn','Heads up','Check your input.','--yellow'],info:['info','FYI','A new version is available.','--cyan']};
$$('[data-toast]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const t=T[b.dataset.toast],el=document.createElement('div');el.className='toast';el.style.setProperty('--c',`var(${t[3]})`);el.innerHTML=`${ic(t[0])}<div><b>${t[1]}</b><br><small style="color:var(--mut)">${t[2]}</small></div>`;$('#toasts').append(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),3500)}));
// loading button
$('#ld').onclick=function(){const s=$('.spin',this);s.hidden=false;this.disabled=true;setTimeout(()=>{s.hidden=true;this.disabled=false},1800)};
// hamburger / sidebar
const W=$('.wrap'),H=$('#hb');let nav=innerWidth>860;const applyNav=()=>{W.classList.toggle('closed',!nav);W.classList.toggle('open',nav);H.setAttribute('aria-expanded',nav)};applyNav();
H.onclick=()=>{nav=!nav;applyNav()};$$('nav.side a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(innerWidth<=860){nav=false;applyNav()}}));
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&innerWidth<=860&&nav){nav=false;applyNav();H.focus()}});
// heatmap
$('#hm').innerHTML=Array.from({length:84},(_,i)=>`<i style="opacity:${(.12+Math.abs(Math.sin(i*1.7)*Math.cos(i*.4))*.88).toFixed(2)}"></i>`).join('');
// card spotlight
$$('.card').forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',e.clientX-r.left+'px');c.style.setProperty('--my',e.clientY-r.top+'px')}));
// counter + scrollspy
const cn=$('[data-to]');new IntersectionObserver((en,o)=>{if(en[0].isIntersecting){const to=+cn.dataset.to,t0=performance.now();(function f(t){const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1500);cn.textContent='$'+Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3))).toLocaleString();p<1&&requestAnimationFrame(f)})(t0);o.disconnect()}}).observe(cn);
const links=$$('nav.side a');new IntersectionObserver(en=>en.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)links.forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+e.target.id))}),{rootMargin:'-30% 0px -65% 0px'}).observe&&$$('section').forEach(s=>new IntersectionObserver(en=>en.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)links.forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+s.id))}),{rootMargin:'-30% 0px -65% 0px'}).observe(s));


/* ===== SSOT additions ===== */
(function(){
  var loc = new URL(location.href);
  var hosted = /^https?:$/.test(loc.protocol);
  var ref = hosted ? loc.href.split('#')[0] : loc.pathname.split('/').pop();
  $('#follow-prompt').textContent = 'Follow this design system: ' + ref;
  function copyText(text,btn){
    var label=btn?btn.textContent:'';
    var finish=function(){if(btn){btn.textContent='Copied';setTimeout(function(){btn.textContent=label},1400)}};
    var fallback=function(){var ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=text;ta.setAttribute('readonly','');ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:-9999px;opacity:0';document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();try{document.execCommand('copy')}catch(e){}ta.remove();finish()};
    if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(finish,fallback)}else{fallback()}
  }
  $('#copy-prompt').addEventListener('click',function(){copyText('Follow this design system: '+ref,this)});
  $('#copy-demo').addEventListener('click',function(){copyText('Inovix text selection token demo');$('[data-toast="success"]').click();});

  var CAT_LABEL={_root:'Foundation documents',a11y:'Accessibility','ai-prompts':'AI prompts',brand:'Brand',contexts:'App contexts','data-display':'Data display',docs:'Documentation',feedback:'Feedback',forms:'Forms',i18n:'Internationalization',layout:'Layout',media:'Media',micro:'Micro components','micro-interactions':'Micro-interactions',navigation:'Navigation',overlays:'Overlays',pages:'Page states',qa:'Quality assurance',theming:'Theming'};
  function implGroups(){
    var map={},order=[];
    $$('.impl-card').forEach(function(c){
      var cat=c.dataset.cat;
      if(!map[cat]){map[cat]=[];order.push(cat)}
      map[cat].push(c);
    });
    return order.map(function(cat){return {label:CAT_LABEL[cat]||cat,items:map[cat]}});
  }
  /* Searchable menu panel: sections + every component. */
  var menuSearch=$('#menu-search');
  if(menuSearch){
    var menuLinks=$$('nav.side > a'),navComp=$('#nav-components'),navMore=$('#nav-more');
    var compNav=[];
    if(navComp){
      implGroups().forEach(function(g){
        var label=g.label;
        var grp=document.createElement('div');grp.className='nav-group';
        var title=document.createElement('button');title.type='button';title.className='nav-group-toggle';
        title.textContent=label;title.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');title.dataset.open='0';
        var sub=document.createElement('div');sub.className='nav-sub';sub.hidden=true;
        title.onclick=function(){var show=sub.hidden;sub.hidden=!show;title.dataset.open=show?'1':'0';title.setAttribute('aria-expanded',show?'true':'false')};
        g.items.forEach(function(tile){
          var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='reg-nav-item';
          b.textContent=tile.dataset.name;b._tile=tile;b.dataset.cat=tile.dataset.cat;
          b.onclick=function(){
            if(innerWidth<=860&&$('#hb').getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true')$('#hb').click();
            goToComponent(b.textContent,tile);
          };
          sub.appendChild(b);compNav.push(b);
        });
        grp.appendChild(title);grp.appendChild(sub);navComp.appendChild(grp);
      });
      navMore.onclick=function(){
        var show=navComp.hidden;
        navComp.hidden=!show;navMore.setAttribute('aria-expanded',show?'true':'false');
        if(show)menuSearch.focus();
      };
    }
    var filterMenu=function(){
      var q=menuSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase(),n=0;
      menuLinks.forEach(function(a){
        var show=!q||a.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1;
        a.classList.toggle('hide-nav',!show);
        if(show)n++;
      });
      compNav.forEach(function(b){
        var show=!!q&&(b.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1||b.dataset.cat.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1);
        b.classList.toggle('hide-nav',!show);
        var sub=b.parentNode,head=sub&&sub.previousElementSibling;
        if(show&&sub){sub.hidden=false;if(head)head.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true')}
        else if(!q&&sub&&head){sub.hidden=head.dataset.open!=='1';head.setAttribute('aria-expanded',head.dataset.open==='1'?'true':'false')}
        if(show)n++;
      });
      if(q&&navComp)navComp.hidden=false;
      else if(navComp&&navMore.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true')navComp.hidden=true;
      $('#menu-none').hidden=n>0;
    };
    menuSearch.addEventListener('input',filterMenu);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.activeElement===menuSearch){menuSearch.value='';filterMenu();menuSearch.blur()}
    });
  }

  /* Component menu: every component, searchable, with a jump to its demo or tile. */
  var compBtn=$('#comp-menu-btn'),compMenu=$('#comp-menu'),compList=$('#comp-list'),compInput=$('#comp-search');
  var demoMap={
    'accordion':'#data','button':'#buttons','input':'#forms','checkbox':'#forms','radio':'#forms','switch':'#forms','toggle':'#forms','select':'#forms','textarea':'#forms','range':'#forms','slider':'#forms','validation':'#forms','form-field':'#forms','field-error':'#forms','otp':'#forms','file-upload':'#forms','datepicker':'#forms','timepicker':'#forms','combobox':'#forms','autocomplete':'#forms','multiselect':'#forms','tag-input':'#forms','masked-input':'#forms','rich-text':'#forms','signature':'#forms','colorpicker':'#forms','segmented-control':'#forms','code-block':'#forms','markdown':'#forms','drag-drop-zone':'#forms',
    'badge':'#badges','alert':'#badges','toast':'#feedback','toaster':'#feedback','snackbar':'#feedback','spinner':'#feedback','loader':'#feedback','skeleton':'#feedback','empty-state':'#feedback','error-state':'#feedback','progress-bar':'#data','progress-circle':'#data','notification':'#feedback','banner':'#badges','message':'#badges','success':'#badges','warning':'#badges','info':'#badges','error':'#badges',
    'card':'#cards','kpi':'#cards','stat':'#cards','tile':'#cards','grid':'#cards','list':'#data','table':'#data','data-display':'#data','avatar':'#data','timeline':'#data','tag':'#badges','chip':'#badges','pill':'#badges','label':'#badges','link':'#type','icon':'#type','image':'#media','video':'#media','audio':'#media','qr':'#data','barcode':'#data','calendar':'#data','kanban':'#data','chart-bar':'#charts','chart-line':'#charts','chart-area':'#charts','chart-donut':'#charts','chart-pie':'#charts','chart-gauge':'#charts','chart-heatmap':'#charts','chart-funnel':'#charts','chart-sparkline':'#charts','chart-treemap':'#charts','chart-sankey':'#charts','gantt':'#charts','graph-org':'#data','map-choropleth':'#data',
    'tabs':'#nav','breadcrumbs':'#nav','pagination':'#nav','stepper':'#nav','command-palette':'#nav','menu':'#nav','navbar':'#nav','context-menu':'#nav','workflow-breadcrumbs':'#nav',
    'modal':'#overlays','dialog':'#overlays','drawer':'#overlays','sheet':'#overlays','dropdown':'#overlays','popover':'#overlays','tooltip':'#overlays','scrim':'#overlays','overlay':'#overlays','confirm':'#overlays','lightbox':'#overlays','prompt':'#overlays',
    'logo':'#brand','color':'#colors','typography':'#type','theme':'#foundations','theming':'#foundations','holy-grail':'#apprules','sidebar':'#apprules','header':'#apprules','footer':'#apprules','a11y':'#qa','qa':'#qa'
  };
  function implSlug(name){return 'impl-'+String(name).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g,'')}
  function goToComponent(name,tile){
    var key=String(name).toLowerCase();
    var target=(tile&&tile.classList&&tile.classList.contains('impl-card'))?tile
      :$$('.impl-card').find(function(c){return c.dataset.name.toLowerCase()===key})
      ||document.getElementById(implSlug(name))
      ||tile;
    if(!target)return;
    var implFilter=$('#impl-search');
    if(implFilter&&implFilter.value){implFilter.value='';implFilter.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))}
    $$('.impl-card').forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('hide-nav')});
    var ic=$('#impl-count');if(ic)ic.textContent=$$('.impl-card').length+' shown';
    $$('.comp-hit').forEach(function(e){e.classList.remove('comp-hit')});
    target.classList.add('comp-hit');
    setTimeout(function(){target.classList.remove('comp-hit')},4000);
    var root=document.documentElement,prev=root.style.scrollBehavior;
    root.style.scrollBehavior='auto';
    target.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});
    root.style.scrollBehavior=prev;
  }
  var usedIds={};
  $$('[id]').forEach(function(e){usedIds[e.id]=1});
  $$('.impl-card').forEach(function(c){
    var base=implSlug(c.dataset.name),id=base,k=1;
    while(usedIds[id]){id=implSlug(c.dataset.cat+'-'+c.dataset.name)+(k>1?'-'+k:'');k++}
    c.id=id;usedIds[id]=1;
    var sel=demoMap[c.dataset.name.toLowerCase()],meta=c.querySelector('.impl-meta');
    if(sel&&$(sel)&&meta){
      var a=document.createElement('a');a.className='impl-section-link';a.href=sel;a.textContent='Open in section →';
      meta.appendChild(a);
    }
  });
  if(compBtn&&compMenu&&compList&&compInput){
    var groups=[];
    implGroups().forEach(function(g){
      groups.push({label:g.label,items:g.items});
    });
    $('#comp-count').textContent=groups.reduce(function(n,g){return n+g.items.length},0)+' items';
    function renderComp(q){
      q=(q||'').toLowerCase();var count=0;compList.innerHTML='';
      groups.forEach(function(g){
        var items=g.items.filter(function(el){return !q||el.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1||g.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1});
        if(!items.length)return;count+=items.length;
        var sec=document.createElement('section');sec.className='comp-group';
        var b=document.createElement('b');b.textContent=g.label+' ';
        var n=document.createElement('span');n.textContent=items.length;b.appendChild(n);
        var wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='comp-items';
        items.forEach(function(it){
          var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.textContent=it.textContent;
          btn.onclick=function(){openComp(false);goToComponent(it.textContent,it)};
          wrap.appendChild(btn);
        });
        sec.appendChild(b);sec.appendChild(wrap);compList.appendChild(sec);
      });
      if(!count)compList.innerHTML='<div class="comp-empty">No components match your search</div>';
    }
    function openComp(on){
      compMenu.classList.toggle('open',on);
      compMenu.setAttribute('aria-hidden',on?'false':'true');
      compBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on?'true':'false');
      if(on)setTimeout(function(){compInput.focus()},140);
    }
    compBtn.onclick=function(){openComp(!compMenu.classList.contains('open'))};
    $('#comp-close').onclick=function(){openComp(false)};
    compMenu.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===compMenu)openComp(false)});
    compInput.addEventListener('input',function(){renderComp(compInput.value)});
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Escape'&&compMenu.classList.contains('open'))openComp(false);
      if(e.key==='/'&&compMenu.classList.contains('open')){e.preventDefault();compInput.focus();compInput.select()}
    });
    renderComp('');
  }

  /* Page-wide search: searches every section's rendered text and jumps to matches. */
  var pageSearch=$('#page-search'),resultsBox=$('#page-results');
  if(pageSearch&&resultsBox){
    var escHtml=function(x){return String(x).replace(/[&<>]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]})};
    var sections=$$('main section').map(function(sec){
      var h=sec.querySelector('h2,h3');
      return {el:sec,id:sec.id,title:h?h.textContent.trim():sec.id,text:(sec.innerText||sec.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ')};
    });
    var hits=[];
    var clearHits=function(){
      hits.forEach(function(e){e.classList.remove('search-hit')});hits=[];
      $$('.search-flash').forEach(function(e){e.classList.remove('search-flash')});
    };
    var jumpTo=function(s,q){
      resultsBox.hidden=true;clearHits();
      s.el.classList.add('search-flash');
      var walker=document.createTreeWalker(s.el,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),n;
      while((n=walker.nextNode())){
        if(n.nodeValue.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1&&n.parentElement&&!n.parentElement.closest('.page-results'))hits.push(n.parentElement);
      }
      hits.slice(0,25).forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('search-hit')});
      var root=document.documentElement,prev=root.style.scrollBehavior;
      root.style.scrollBehavior='auto';
      (hits[0]||s.el).scrollIntoView({block:'center'});
      root.style.scrollBehavior=prev;
      setTimeout(clearHits,4500);
    };
    var snippet=function(text,q){
      var i=text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q);if(i<0)return escHtml(text.slice(0,90));
      var a=Math.max(0,i-40),b=Math.min(text.length,i+q.length+70);
      return (a?'…':'')+escHtml(text.slice(a,i))+'<mark>'+escHtml(text.slice(i,i+q.length))+'</mark>'+escHtml(text.slice(i+q.length,b))+(b<text.length?'…':'');
    };
    var lastComps=[];
    var runSearch=function(){
      var q=pageSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if(q.length<2){resultsBox.hidden=true;resultsBox.innerHTML='';return}
      var found=sections.filter(function(s){return s.text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1});
      lastComps=$$('.impl-card').filter(function(e){return e.dataset.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1}).slice(0,8);
      var sectionHtml=found.slice(0,10).map(function(s){
        var i=sections.indexOf(s);
        return '<button role="option" data-i="'+i+'"><span class="t">'+escHtml(s.title)+'</span><span class="s">'+snippet(s.text,q)+'</span></button>';
      }).join('');
      var compHtml=lastComps.map(function(e,i){
        return '<button role="option" class="comp-result" data-ci="'+i+'"><span class="t">'+escHtml(e.dataset.name)+'</span><span class="s">'+escHtml(e.dataset.cat)+'</span></button>';
      }).join('');
      resultsBox.innerHTML=(sectionHtml+compHtml)||'<div class="none">No matches on this page</div>';
      resultsBox.hidden=false;
      $$('button[data-i]',resultsBox).forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){jumpTo(sections[+b.dataset.i],q)}});
      $$('button[data-ci]',resultsBox).forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){resultsBox.hidden=true;var t=lastComps[+b.dataset.ci];goToComponent(t.textContent,t)}});
    };
    pageSearch.addEventListener('input',runSearch);
    pageSearch.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Escape'){pageSearch.value='';resultsBox.hidden=true;clearHits();pageSearch.blur()}
      if(e.key==='Enter'){var b=$('button',resultsBox);if(b)b.click()}
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      var typing=/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(document.activeElement.tagName);
      if((e.key==='/'||((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='k'))&&!typing){e.preventDefault();pageSearch.focus();pageSearch.select()}
    });
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!e.target.closest('.global-search'))resultsBox.hidden=true});
  }

  /* Wheel targets the scrollable component under the pointer, not the page. */
  document.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){
    if(e.defaultPrevented||e.ctrlKey)return;
    var el=e.target,dy=e.deltaY,dx=e.deltaX;
    while(el&&el!==document.body){
      if(el.nodeType!==1){el=el.parentNode;continue}
      var cs=getComputedStyle(el);
      var oy=cs.overflowY,ox=cs.overflowX;
      var canY=(oy==='auto'||oy==='scroll')&&el.scrollHeight>el.clientHeight+1;
      var canX=(ox==='auto'||ox==='scroll')&&el.scrollWidth>el.clientWidth+1;
      if(dy&&canY){
        var room=dy>0?el.scrollHeight-el.clientHeight-el.scrollTop:el.scrollTop;
        if(room>0.5){e.preventDefault();el.scrollTop+=dy;return}
      }
      if(dx&&canX){
        var roomX=dx>0?el.scrollWidth-el.clientWidth-el.scrollLeft:el.scrollLeft;
        if(roomX>0.5){e.preventDefault();el.scrollLeft+=dx;return}
      }
      el=el.parentElement;
    }
  },{passive:false});

  /* Scroll-to-top */
  var toTop=$('#totop');
  if(toTop){
    var updateTop=function(){toTop.classList.toggle('on',window.scrollY>420)};
    window.addEventListener('scroll',updateTop,{passive:true});updateTop();
    toTop.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
      var root=document.documentElement,prev=root.style.scrollBehavior;
      root.style.scrollBehavior='auto';
      if(reduced){window.scrollTo(0,0);root.style.scrollBehavior=prev;return}
      var start=window.scrollY||root.scrollTop||0,t0=performance.now(),dur=460;
      (function step(){
        var p=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur),e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
        window.scrollTo(0,start*(1-e));
        if(p<1)setTimeout(step,16);
        else{root.style.scrollBehavior=prev;updateTop()}
      })();
    });
  }

  var frames=[$('#deckframe'),$('#deckframe2')];
  frames.forEach(function(f){if(f&&DECK_DATA)f.src='data:text/html;base64,'+DECK_DATA});
  var full=$('#deckfull');
  function setFull(on){
    void full.offsetWidth;
    full.classList.toggle('open',on);
    document.body.style.overflow=on?'hidden':'';
    if(on)setTimeout(function(){try{frames[1].focus()}catch(e){}},620);
  }
  $('#deck-open').addEventListener('click',function(){setFull(true)});
  $('#deck-close').addEventListener('click',function(){setFull(false)});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&full.classList.contains('open'))setFull(false)});

  /* slide templates */
  var tpls=[
    ['Cover / title','Cover','Gradient wordmark, lead, stats, orbit visual',0],
    ['About / split','Statement','Two-column about with pill grid',1],
    ['Bento capabilities','Grid','Accent cards with icons and chip rows',2],
    ['Technology coverage','Catalog','Dense icon-and-label card grid',3],
    ['Reference architecture','Architecture','Vertical spine with animated packet and nodes',4],
    ['Product spotlight','Product','Big product name, parallax hexagon, cert strip',5],
    ['Partnerships','Partners','Tiered partner cards and integration flow',6],
    ['Client marquee','Proof','Auto-duplicated seamless logo track',7],
    ['Talent partner','Split','Stair steps and journey pills',8],
    ['Innovation partner','Compare','Three-column use-case chain with chart',9],
    ['Delivery models','Chevrons','Shimmering chevron process row',10],
    ['Business models','Cards','Stacked pricing-style comparison cards',11],
    ['Delivery framework','Gates','Six capability gates with checklists',12],
    ['Why Inovix','Metrics','Proof points, KPI counters and badges',13],
    ['GCC capability','Stairs','Capability maturity steps',14],
    ['Engagement roadmap','Gantt','Quartered timeline with animated bars',15],
    ['Closing / contact','Close','Thanks gradient, contact cards, QR',16]
  ];
  var host=$('#tplgrid');
  if(host){
    host.innerHTML=tpls.map(function(t,i){
      return '<div class="tpl" data-slide="'+t[3]+'" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open '+htmlAttr(t[0])+' in reference deck">'
        +'<div class="thumb"><span class="k">'+htmlText(t[1])+'</span><span>'+htmlText(t[0])+'</span><i style="width:'+(40+(i*7)%55)+'%"></i><i style="width:'+(25+(i*11)%45)+'%;opacity:.45"></i></div>'
        +'<div class="cap"><b>'+htmlText(t[0])+'</b><span>Slide '+(t[3]+1)+'</span></div></div>';
    }).join('');
    function openSlide(n){
      setFull(true);
      setTimeout(function(){
        try{
          var w=frames[1].contentWindow;
          w.location.hash='#s'+(n+1);
          w.postMessage({type:'ix-slide',slide:n},'*');
        }catch(e){}
        try{frames[1].src='data:text/html;base64,'+DECK_DATA+'#s'+(n+1)}catch(e){}
      },120);
    }
    $$('.tpl').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('click',function(){openSlide(+el.dataset.slide)});
      el.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();openSlide(+el.dataset.slide)}});
    });
  }
  function htmlText(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]})}
  function htmlAttr(s){return htmlText(s).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var $=function(q,r){return (r||document).querySelector(q)};
  var $$=function(q,r){return [].slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(q))};
  var hb=$('#hb-demo');
  if(hb){hb.addEventListener('click',function(){var on=hb.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true';hb.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on?'true':'false');$('#hb-panel').classList.toggle('open',on)})}
  var ind=$('#indet');if(ind)ind.indeterminate=true;
  var combo=$('#combo-input'),list=$('#combo-list');
  if(combo&&list){
    combo.addEventListener('focus',function(){list.hidden=false});
    combo.addEventListener('input',function(){var q=combo.value.toLowerCase();$$('li',list).forEach(function(li){li.classList.toggle('hide-nav',li.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)})});
    $$('li',list).forEach(function(li){li.addEventListener('click',function(){combo.value=li.textContent;list.hidden=true})});
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!e.target.closest('.combo'))list.hidden=true});
  }
  var gload=$('#gallery-load');
  if(gload){gload.addEventListener('click',function(){var sp=$('.spin',this);sp.hidden=false;this.disabled=true;setTimeout(function(){sp.hidden=true;gload.disabled=false},1300)})}
  var ariaBtn=$('#aria-demo');
  if(ariaBtn){ariaBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){$('#aria-status').textContent='Saved just now'})}
  var loc=$('#locale-select');
  if(loc){
    var fmt=function(){
      var l=loc.value,d=new Date('2026-11-26T10:30:00Z');
      $('#fmt-date').textContent=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(l,{dateStyle:'medium',timeZone:'UTC'}).format(d);
      $('#fmt-num').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat(l).format(1234567.89);
      $('#fmt-cur').textContent=new Intl.NumberFormat(l,{style:'currency',currency:l==='hi-IN'?'INR':l==='ar-SA'?'SAR':l==='de-DE'?'EUR':'USD'}).format(48200);
      $('#fmt-tz').textContent=Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
      document.documentElement.lang=l;
    };
    loc.addEventListener('change',fmt);fmt();
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  var q=document.getElementById('impl-search'),grid=document.getElementById('impl-grid'),count=document.getElementById('impl-count');
  if(!q||!grid)return;
  q.addEventListener('input',function(){
    var v=q.value.trim().toLowerCase(),n=0;
    [].slice.call(grid.children).forEach(function(c){
      var show=!v||c.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(v)>-1;
      c.classList.toggle('hide-nav',!show);if(show)n++;
    });
    count.textContent=n+' shown';
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  var fit=function(el){
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),tip=el.getAttribute('data-tip')||'',w=tip.length*7+26;
    el.classList.toggle('tip-below',r.top<52);
    el.classList.toggle('tip-left',r.right+w/2>window.innerWidth-8||r.left+w/2<8);
  };
  [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.tip')).forEach(function(el){
    ['pointerenter','focusin'].forEach(function(ev){el.addEventListener(ev,function(){fit(el)})});
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.tip')).forEach(fit)});
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  var $=function(q,r){return (r||document).querySelector(q)};
  var $$=function(q,r){return [].slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(q))};
  var label=function(b){return ((b.textContent||'')||b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'Action').trim().slice(0,44)};
  function toast(msg){
    var box=$('#toasts');if(!box)return;
    var el=document.createElement('div');el.className='toast';el.style.setProperty('--c','var(--blue)');
    var ic=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');ic.setAttribute('class','ic');
    var use=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','use');use.setAttribute('href','#i-info');ic.appendChild(use);
    var d=document.createElement('div'),b=document.createElement('b'),sm=document.createElement('small');
    b.textContent=msg;sm.textContent='Demo interaction';sm.style.color='var(--mut)';
    d.appendChild(b);d.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));d.appendChild(sm);
    el.appendChild(ic);el.appendChild(d);box.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(function(){el.remove()},2600);
  }
  var dlg=document.createElement('div');dlg.className='scrim';dlg.id='impl-demo-dialog';dlg.setAttribute('role','dialog');dlg.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  var panel=document.createElement('div');panel.className='modal';
  var head=document.createElement('header');
  var ico=document.createElement('span');ico.className='ico';ico.style.setProperty('--c','var(--violet)');
  var h3=document.createElement('h3');h3.id='impl-demo-dialog-title';
  var close=document.createElement('button');close.className='btn gh ib sm';close.setAttribute('data-close','');close.setAttribute('aria-label','Close');close.innerHTML='<svg class="ic"><use href="#i-x"/></svg>';
  head.appendChild(ico);head.appendChild(h3);head.appendChild(close);
  var body=document.createElement('p');body.id='impl-demo-dialog-body';body.style.color='var(--mut)';
  var foot=document.createElement('footer');var ok=document.createElement('button');ok.className='btn b-primary';ok.setAttribute('data-close','');ok.textContent='Got it';foot.appendChild(ok);
  panel.appendChild(head);panel.appendChild(body);panel.appendChild(foot);dlg.appendChild(panel);document.body.appendChild(dlg);
  function openDialog(card){
    h3.textContent=card?card.dataset.name:'Component demo';
    body.textContent=card?(card.querySelector('.impl-desc')?card.querySelector('.impl-desc').textContent:'Rendered component demo.'):'Rendered component demo.';
    dlg.classList.add('open');close.focus();
  }
  close.onclick=function(){dlg.classList.remove('open')};ok.onclick=function(){dlg.classList.remove('open')};
  dlg.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===dlg)dlg.classList.remove('open')});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&dlg.classList.contains('open'))dlg.classList.remove('open')});
  $$('.impl-card button[data-open]').forEach(function(b){
    var card=b.closest('.impl-card');
    b.removeAttribute('data-open');b.setAttribute('data-impl-modal','');b.onclick=function(e){e.stopPropagation();openDialog(card)};
  });
  $$('main button').forEach(function(b){
    if(b.disabled||b.onclick||b.hasAttribute('data-open')||b.hasAttribute('data-toast')||b.hasAttribute('data-close')||b.hasAttribute('data-tip')||b.hasAttribute('data-slide')||b.hasAttribute('data-i')||b.hasAttribute('data-ci')||b.hasAttribute('data-impl-modal')||b.closest('.tabs')||b.closest('.pg')||b.closest('details'))return;
    b.onclick=function(e){e.stopPropagation();var card=b.closest('.impl-card');toast((card?card.dataset.name+': ':'')+label(b))};
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  var $$=function(q,r){return [].slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(q))};
  $$('main input,main select,main textarea').forEach(function(el){
    if(el.type==='hidden'||el.hasAttribute('aria-label')||el.closest('label'))return;
    if(el.id&&document.querySelector('label[for="'+el.id+'"]'))return;
    var card=el.closest('.impl-card');
    var name=el.getAttribute('placeholder')||el.getAttribute('value')||el.type||(card?card.dataset.name:'component');
    el.setAttribute('aria-label',String(name).trim().slice(0,60));
  });
})();
</script>

Universal dispatch

verb "build / create / implement app"   -> App starter template
verb "make / build / create presentation" -> Presentation starter template

Always output ONE new standalone .html file.
Never link to or embed this design system file.
Never invent colours, fonts, spacing or logos.
Validate before replying: theme toggle, responsive layout,
keyboard access, reduced motion, no console errors.

Presentation system

The live corporate deck below is the canonical reference for every HTML presentation. It is embedded verbatim from the canonical corporate deck — same CSS, same slide engine, same 17 slides.

Dual mode

Mandatory presentation checklist — read before generating

  1. One standalone HTML file. Copy the Presentation starter below; change only the slide content. Never link, embed, or summarise this design system.
  2. Full-bleed 16:9 stage with one active slide at a time. No scrolling article layout.
  3. Every dimension derives from --u:min(1vw,1.7778vh). No invented rem/clamp spacing.
  4. Deck engine: active/before/after states, progress segments, counter, hash deep links #sN, inactive slides aria-hidden.
  5. Navigation: ← → ↑ ↓, Space/Enter/PageDown, Backspace/PageUp, Home/End, F fullscreen, M menu, sN direct slide, wheel and touch swipe.
  6. HUD: exact three-line, text-only lockup — INOVIX / SOFTWARE LABS / ENGINEERING INTELLIGENCE, SECURING THE FUTURE — in DejaVu Sans 400. No icon, image, emoji or gradient mark.
  7. Decoration: seeded ring, dots, cross, blob and diamond with parallax, plus three drifting blurred orbs and a masked grid.
  8. Cards: glass surfaces, cursor-following radial spotlight, hover scale and accent border.
  9. Entrances: staggered variants rise, left, right, zoom, fade, grow and grow-y.
  10. Reduced motion disables all animation/transition; focus-visible rings remain.

Slide count: the canonical deck has 17 slides. For a new topic, use 5–17 sparse slides chosen by content — never pad to 17, never exceed 17. One idea per slide, 3–5 cards max.

Visual regression reference: the live deck below is the pixel reference. Slide 1 has the eyebrow, large Sora title, one supporting line and a three-card bento on a dark navy stage with orbs and geometry; the HUD lockup sits top-left, progress and counter bottom-centre. Match that before shipping.

Live reference deck · 17 slides · keyboard, wheel, touch and hash navigation
Click the stage, then use ← →, PageUp/Down, Space, Home, End, M for menu, F for fullscreen. Segments and the slide menu are interactive.

Presentation rules

  • One self-contained HTML file. Inline CSS and vanilla JS, no build step, no framework. Only external resource is the pinned Google Fonts stylesheet for Inter and Sora.
  • Full-bleed 16:9 stage. Every dimension derives from --u:min(1vw,1.7778vh), so 1u is 1% of stage width and 1.7778vh of height. Type uses max(base-px, calc(var(--u)*factor)) with a hard minimum.
  • Exact palette: --bg #050A1C, --ink #EAF0FF, --mut #9DABD0, --dim #7080A8, --line rgba(160,185,255,.15); accents blue #3B82F6, cyan #22D3EE, teal #2DD4BF, violet #9B7BFF, amber #FBBF24.
  • Background: radial navy gradients, masked grid, three drifting blurred orbs, deterministic seeded deco per slide (ring, dots, cross, blob, diamond) with parallax at data-depth.
  • Cards: glass gradient surface, 14px backdrop blur, hairline border, cursor-following radial spotlight, hover scale 1.015 and accent border.
  • Deck engine window.__deck toggles .active/.before/.after, updates aria-hidden, progress segments, menu and counter, moves orbs, runs counters and supports #sN deep links.
  • Entrance stagger: every .a element gets --i; delay is .2s + i*.075s. Variants: rise, fromleft, fromright, zoom, fade, grow, growy.
  • Text-only INOVIX lockup in the HUD. No logo image, no emoji. Brand navy and white only.
  • Breakpoint 900px: --u:9px, grids collapse to 1fr, slides scroll vertically, decorative elements reduce. Reduced motion zeroes animations, particle draw and parallax.
  • Accessibility: inactive slides aria-hidden="true", labelled buttons, decorative SVG marked hidden, focus-visible cyan ring, meaningful icons paired with text.

Keyboard contract

InputAction
← / ↑ / BackspacePrevious slide
→ / ↓ / PageDown / Space / EnterNext slide
Home / EndFirst / last slide
FFullscreen
M / EscOpen / close slide menu
Wheel / touch swipeNext / previous slide
#sNDeep link to slide N

Counters animate with Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3))) over 1.5s. The marquee track is duplicated at init for a seamless 46s loop.

17 patterns

Building an app

Rules an agent follows when asked to build an App using the Inovix design system.

Apps

Mandatory app recipe

  1. Output the real app in the requested framework. Load Inter 400/500/600/700 and DejaVu Sans 400 from the pinned sources in the token reference; never use DejaVu Sans for UI text.
  2. Use the Holy Grail shell: fixed navy #03182D header, top-left three-line text-only INOVIX lockup, animated hamburger-to-X, collapsible fixed sidebar, fluid main region as the only scroll container, always-visible footer with the dynamic current year.
  3. Copy the full :root token block from this document into the app's one token file. Every visual value references a token. No hardcoded colors, spacing, radii, shadows, z-index or durations in components.
  4. Page heading rhythm: breadcrumbs → --space-3 → title → --space-1 → one supporting line → --space-6 → content card. Never let flex or grid stretch those gaps.
  5. Content card: raised surface, hairline border, large radius, header row, body fields, footer row with buttons inside the card. Labels above fields, Required marker, helper/error below, 3rem inputs, token focus ring.
  6. Primary action: navy in light theme with white text; bright navy-family #79B6F4 in dark theme with navy text. Secondary action is ghost. Icon-only buttons need aria-label and tooltip.
  7. Every data-driven component ships a skeleton with the matching shape, 1400ms shimmer, and empty, loading, error and offline states.
  8. Define all 26 states from this page for every interactive component, including cursor, sound (silent by default), responsive behavior, RTL mirror, print and ARIA.
  9. Light and dark themes both work; first visit follows the OS; theme is one root attribute swap. Header stays navy with white lockup in both.
  10. Keyboard, focus-visible, WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum body contrast, 3:1 UI/focus, 44px touch targets, forced-colors and reduced motion are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

Never

  • Gradient square, SVG, PNG, emoji or icon as the logo.
  • Fixed 64px header or 240px sidebar instead of clamp tokens.
  • main as a flex column with --space-section gaps between breadcrumbs, title, subtitle and card.
  • Pure gray or pure black neutrals, neon semantic colors, or a second interactive accent hue.
  • Converting a shadow token to another format; copy verbatim.
  • Right sidebar; the shell is Holy Grail with no right rail.

Always

  • Semantic token names only: --color-text-secondary, never "gray-500".
  • Lucide icons by name, sized by --icon-size-*, stroke 1.5 default.
  • Collapse → stack → hide in that order; display:none is never the only responsive response.
  • Text with icon for status; color alone never carries meaning.
  • Information modal: tinted icon circle, title, label/value rows, one primary button, blurred scrim, focus trap, Escape and scrim close, focus returns.
  • One token-file swap for white-label rebrands; no component edits.

Quality bar

Check this before shipping an app or a deck.

Definition of done

Visual

Brand lockup exact, palette exact, spacing on the 8px scale, elevation on the token scale, glass has a solid fallback, no drift from this file.

Interaction

All 26 states, hover lift, focus ring, loading, skeleton, toast, modal, drawer, tooltip and reduced-motion path verified.

Accessibility

Keyboard only pass, focus order, ARIA names, live regions, AA contrast, 44px targets, forced colors, RTL mirror.

Responsive

320, 640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536px checks. Collapse, stack, hide in order. No horizontal overflow.

Self-contained

One HTML file, embedded CSS and JS, inline SVG sprites, inlined images. Only external resource is the pinned font stylesheet.

Implementation library

Every named component, context, chart, graph, map, micro pattern and i18n rule used by the request is present in the implementation library below.

Regression rule

Fixes must not change an already-correct token, state, layout or interaction. Verify visually after each change and keep every previously working pattern intact.
